tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes me chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī kī la ya karma tsa tur ho tri dzña na dzwa la ma hā agni nā ma gu ru tsa badzra ku mā ra pā dā ya na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'bar ba'i me chen zhes bya ba bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal bde stong zung 'jug 'gyur med bde chen kun tu bzang / /dpal ldan 'og min zhing gtso nges pa lnga ldan longs sku rdo rje sems/ /dregs ldan lha srin 'dul mdzad 'dzam gling mgon po ste/ /rnam gsum dbyer med khyab bdag bla ma spyi bos mchod/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /mngon sum zhal bstan gsung gi lung bstan thob/ /thugs rjes rjes bzung 'khon ston klu dbang sogs/ /'gran bral 'khon ston rim byon rnams la 'dud/ /phyag na padmo'i rnam sprul kun dga'i mtshan/ /puṇya gra dang kīrta dhwa dza'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs khu dbon bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan mchog tshogs rnams rgyal/ /khyad par snyigs dus sems can las dbang gis/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma bdud sprin gyis bsgribs tshe/ /thugs rje'i rlung gis pha mthar skrod mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog la phyag 'tshal/ /gang de'i thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug kun dga' dbang rgyal sogs/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs gnas/ /rim byon skyes chen de dag phyag gi yul/ /rdo rje rnon po gzhan ngor gos dkar 'dzin/ /ris med bstan 'gro'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /gnas lnga rig pa kun dga' bsod nams zhabs/ /rnam 'dren gang der lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' bkra shis mtshan/

/'khor lo'i mgon po bsod nams rin chen sogs/ /rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med rnams la 'dud/ /gang sku dbang sngon lhun por tsha zer 'khyud 'dra bdud snying dpa' 'phrog he ru ka /rnam thar zhal ldan phyin drug phyag dang bsdu dngos zhabs ldan badzra ku mā ra/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis 'khyud dbang phyug u ma byi chings bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /gar dgu sgyur mdzad rgyal ba'i phrin las kun 'dus rdo rje gzhon nu rgyal gyur cig /che mchog ya mānta ka padma dbang / /dpal chen yang dag bdud rtsi yon tan lha/ /phrin las phur bu ma mo rbod gtong tshogs/ /drag sngags 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs mchod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i ded dpon che/ /gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi nor skyong zung / /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sogs/ /dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i shes pas skyong / /padma'i spyan sngar khas blangs zhing bcu'i gshed/ /dkar bdud lcam dral dam can bcu gnyis dang / /bstan ma bcu gnyis gying chen skyes bu gsum/ /bse lcags dung sogs dregs byed tshogs rnams mchod/ khams gsum dbugs 'byin rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /dzaṃ lha la sogs gter bdag srung ma'i tshogs/ /rin chen 'dod dgu'i char phob 'dzam gling gi /skye 'gro'i dbul ba sel ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar mchod 'os rnams la gus btud nas/ /bstan dang dad ldan slob mar phan pa'i phyir/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga bshad/ /bdag lta dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung kyang / /dug gsum shugs kyis blo gros snang ba 'grib/ /de lta mod kyang rgya bod tshad ldan gyi/ /gzhung dang bstun te 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /'dir ni mkhas mang dga' ba'i legs bshad cha/ /ma mchis mod kyang lhag bsam rab dkar bas/ /bdag 'dra'i byis blo'i tshogs la phan phyir du/

/gsal bar ngag gis bshad la su zhig bsnyon/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ de la 'dir dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'di la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu zab cing ches zab pa'i lugs srol shin tu mang ba zhig yod kyang / mdor bsdu na phur pa sa lugs/ khyi nag gyang 'gyel lugs/ phur pa jo mo lugs/ lam lags byang chub rdo rje nas brgyud pa ste lugs srol chen po bzhir 'dug pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi dngos slob sad mi mi bdun gyi nang tshan nā ganḍe rakṣi ta ste/ bod skad du klu dbang srung ba zhes pa'i 'khon ston chen po rdo rje gzhon nu dang / zhal mi gnyis pa de nyid kyis slob dpon chen po'i dgongs pa dang mthun par legs par bkral zhing thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi snying por mdzad cing / de nas 'khon ston rdo rje rin chen sogs drag sngags kyi nus mthu dang ldan pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes la/ de rjes phyag na padmo'i rnam sprul rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras rjes 'brangs zhal slob kyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi yang snying thun mong ma yin pa'i dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu sa lugs su grags pa 'di la yang zab cing rgya che ba'i chos skor mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas 'dir phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya tshul gyi lag len khrigs chags bsdebs te/ bdag dang don gnyer gyi slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir 'bri ba la don bzhi ste/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dbang gi sbyin sreg drag po'i sbyin sreg dang bzhi'o/ /dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la yang gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /sngon 'gro la'ang gsum ste/ thab khung bshad pa/ rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa/ rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang dus kha blta phyogs bshad pa'o/

/dang po thab khung ni phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud las/ khru gang zlum po bdud rtsis byugs/ /de la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /zhes dang yakṣa me dbal bsreg pa'i 'phyong las/ zlum po zhi ba chen po ste/ /thig le chen po'i klong du rtsig /ces gsungs pa ltar thog mar gnas khang dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i sar chag chag dang phyi dor legs par byas/ gnas gsar pa yin na sa chog dang / de ma yin pa'i gnas khang byin can gzhan du ni mi dgos la/ gang ltar phyogs der sa phag la sogs pa'i thab stan rgyar khru gang pa/ dpang su rkang gang tsam yod pa'i sar 'jim pas zhal ba legs par byas la sa dkar dang 'byor tshe tsandan dkar po'i khu bas byug der srad bu btsan dmar gyis byugs pa'i thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa bskor ba kha khyer dang / slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzoms pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi legs par sbrel ba'i steng du gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ zhes pa las ma gsungs kyang da ltar gyi phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha ga gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni/ bri bya la mig sngar mdzes pa dang sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo'i lte ba dang / phyi'i sum gnyis la rtsibs bcu pa rnams bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung rdo rje kha zlum po'i phreng bas bskor ba kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir rdo rje'ang dmar por bri/ de'ang rdul tshon gyis 'bri tshe thab khung rdul tshon dkar pos gzhi thams cad bris la gcad dang rdo rje rnams dmar pos bya/

'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser po/ mu khyud gnyis la ljang khu bya'o/ /'khor lo'i dbus su nyi gdan la gtso bo yab yum gyi tshon spung sngon po che chung gnyis bya/ rtsibs bcu dang 'khor lo'i phyi'i phyogs bzhir nyi gdan gyi tshon spung dmar po/ shar rtsibs g.yas par tshon spung sngon po/ g.yon par sngo skya me mtshams sngon po/ lho sngon po/ lho nub sngo rkya/ nub g.yas dmar po/ g.yon nag po/ nub byang dkar po/ byang ljang khu/ byang shar ser po rnams che chung gnyis re bya/ 'di rnams la phra phyag gi tshon spung med kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ 'khor lo'i phyi'i phyogs bzhir shar gyi nyi gdan la dkar po/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu rnams re re'am/ yang na dbus dang / rtsibs bcu gnyis dang / phyi'i phyogs bzhi rnams su nas kyi tshon spung bya/ 'di rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / las byed kyi slob dpon gnyis zhal sprod du yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub drangs por gzigs dgos pas de'i don gyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi tshon spungs kyang rten pa'i nub rtsibs g.yas par 'byung / de'i rjes su dpags nas khro bo gzhan sgo ma dang bcas pa'i tshon spungs kyang 'god lugs kyi khungs shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang yo byad bshams pa ni/ gsang rgyud las/ bud shing dkar po'i rim pa la/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rab 'byor na tsher ma can ma yin pa'i 'o ma can gyi shing gis thab khung brtsig cing sreg rdzas su 'bul ba ni/ de ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs pa la nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig kyang bshams la bzhag go /sreg rdzas gzhan yang / yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur wa ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bshams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yam shing gong du bstan pa ltar 'o ma can gyi shing gang yod rung ba ste/

de'i tshad kyang / gsang rgyud las/ sboms su chag gang tshad yin te/ /mdzub gang mchu ru yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ da ltar phyag len la ni/ slob dpon gyi khru gang gi tshad rtsa rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs/ mar ni rab 'bri mar la sogs pa rtsi bcud dang ldan zhing dri zhim pa 'ba' zhig mngar gsum gyi khu ba btigs la bya/ de min na gang yang rung bas so/ /til ni mon dang khams nas thon pa'i til dkar til nag gang rung ngo / /zas mchog ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum mar las brdzis pa'i phye ma'am/ yang na mar skya zhig dang sbyar ba'o/ /so ba ni 'bras kyi so ba/ 'bras ni rgya gar rgya nag mon nas thon pa'i 'bras gang rung ngo / /nas dang gro ni bod nyid nas 'byung la/ sran ma ni rab rgya sran nam/ de min na'ang bod sran gyis rung la/ dur wa yang rgya nag gi dur wa kho na la bya zhing / de min na bod kyi rtsa ram pa la bya'o/ /ku sha'ang rgya gar gyi kho na 'byor tshe rab de med tshe bod kyi 'jag mas kyang rung bar gsungs/ de rnams ni bsreg rdzas yin la/ gzhan yang thab kyi mi gtsang ba sel ba'i kun sha'i chun po/ brgyad po dang yo byad bsang ba'i dri bzang gi chu dung chos 'thor yab dang bcas pa/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod 'o mas kha bsgyur ba/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon na shing stegs la sogs pa'i khar 'byor tshe dngul lam shel dung dkar gyi ting gi nang du gong gi bsreg rdzas rnams go rim ma log par kha gso dang bcas par bshams/ rang gi mdun du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar po la gangs ri chu ris wam̐ bris pa bzhag de'i rgyab lcog rtse'i steng du/ rdor dril ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod 'thor nas/ dgang gzar blug gzar kha sbyar ba rdor dril gyi bar du bzhag gzhan yang ha cang mi 'gyang bar 'byor na rdo rje gzhon nu dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs thab dang yo byad la zhal phyogs par dgram/

de'i mdun du stegs mtho bar ras dkar gyis bkab pa'i steng du 'bru sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar dpal chen po'i gtor ma stod sum gnyis zur gsum dbal can/ smad sum cha zlum po mtheb kyu bzhis bskor ba brgyan par 'byor na mar tshon gyis rtse rgyan la phyag mtshan drug ka'am/ de min na'ang rdo rje rtse dgu pa mtha' me ris kyis bskor ba rtse mor nyi zlas mdzes pa dar nag gi gur mdung thung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang mar sgor me ris sogs lag len bzhin no/ /bsdu na mig gsum mar rgyan ci rigs/ ched du bsad sha ma yin pa'i sha yis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du mi thod tshad ldan dngos sam rdo shing 'khar ba la thod gzugs bcos pa'am yang na sprel thod kyi nang du g.yas su chang gtsang ma tsha skyur dang bral ba la bdud rtsi ril bu bdud rtsi chos sman sogs byin can gyi sman zhib par btags la mdog 'gyur bar btab/ g.yon du g.yag rgod sogs kyi khrag gtsang ma dngos sam khrag skam chang la sbyar ba la/ ga pur/ sihla/ dza ti sogs bsil sman dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ de'i mdun du 'das gtor zlum po gsum mam lnga'am bdun nam bcu gang rung dar nag gi 'phyang 'phrul bcas pa bshams/ bskang ba byed tshe/ bskang gtor kyang phyag len ltar thun gtor dang bcas pa/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ phud chang / gu gul/ spos kyi rings bu sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /gsum pa rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang dus kha blta phyogs bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa sgrub grogs dang bcas pa thams cad gos dkar dang stan dkar 'ba' zhig bya ba'am/ yang slob dpon kho nas shel dkar gyi phreng ba bzung la gos rgyan dkar po'i chas su zhugs shing stan dkar po la skyil mo krung gis lus drang por bsrangs nas 'dug la sems kyis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdug bsngal bar gcod thams cad zhi bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa ste/

de yang gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad nas/ /rmugs pa'i sems can 'gro gang las/ /zhi ba'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dus ni zhi ba la rab dbyar zla ra ba'i nam lang ngam/ de min na zla ba gang rung gi nam lang la'o/ /kha ni shar du blta'o/ /de rnams kyis sngon du 'gro ba thab khung rdzas dang yo byad rgyan dang 'dug stangs bshad pa rnams bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhi ba'i phrin las kyis/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib tshogs/ /zhi byed ngo mtshar rten 'brel rdzas mchog rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsham 'di ma 'khrul dgongs don lags/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yang bzhi ste/ bdag bskyed pa/ thab khung rdzas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul/ bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi sbyin sreg gi dbye ba bstan pa zhar byung 'phros don dang bcas pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ rgyas par ni chos rje bla mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklag pas don grub rig 'dzin bskul yan bya/ bsdu na sa los mdzad pa'i phur chung la sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang pos phyag len rnams mchan bur btab pa nang bzhin gyi bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar rdzogs par bsgoms pa ni bdag bskyed do/ /skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyis me sbar bar bsam/ gnyis pa thab dang yo byad bsangs shing byin gyis brlabs pa ni thog mar gong du bshad pa'i dung phor nang gi dri bzang gi chu la dmigs te rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bha wa shaddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsangs chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/ sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags nyer gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas 'thor yab kyis ku sha'i rtses chu de nyid nas blangs te mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas thams cad la 'thor zhing sngar gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shāpta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra uttha pha la ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi pū ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyis mchod rdzas rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod yon gyi phyag rgya kho na bya zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing dang / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas thams cad sbyong ba ni rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /thab khung byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yang sngar bzhin bsangs chu gtor la/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni thab khung bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs pa mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sma ra ag tshom can drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab la dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po rang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agni ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sa dha ka ma hā bhu ta de wa ṛ ṣi de wi dza satwaṃ/ ma gṛ hi twa/ sarba satwārtha kṛ to āḥhūm̐ ti asminni nni hi to bha wa padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs shing gdan phul/ oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ de nas thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo'i tshigs bar pa'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis btsugs srin lag gnyis lag mthil du bkug mtheb chen dang mthe chung so sor sbyar ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la dam bzhag pa ni/

oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhu ta dzwa la ya sarba duṣṭaṃ bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa tri shya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag de nas rang gi snying kha nas sgo ma bzhi spros la dgug gzhug bcing sdom dbang du mdzad par bsam zhing / lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / oṃ badzra pakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje gnod sbyin mas me lha ye shes par lcags kyus reg pas dam tshig pa'i spyi bor spyan drangs/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yon pa'i rgyab bzhag pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra bhai ra we hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje 'jigs byed mas me lha'i zhabs la zhags pa reg pas dam tshig pa'i spyi bo nas bstim par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur las mthe chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mthur kha gyen du bstan pa lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje bdud rtsi mas me lha dam tshig pa'i zhabs la lcags sgrog reg pas dam ye gnyis dbyer med du byas/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du bzhag nas bskyod pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje gsod byed mas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra bsgrags pas skad cig kyang mi 'bral zhing brten par byas par bsam mo/ /de nas dbang lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/

zhes pas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab/ de nas gong du bshad pa'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsangs chu gtor la/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyi thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yis ni dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing las kyi rdo rje la sprad la/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod cing g.yas bskor gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkram/ sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed pa me sbar bar bshad kyang / phyag len la skabs 'dir mdzad pas bram ze rgyun bzhag gi me'am me shel las byung ba dang / shing 'o ma can btsugs pa las byung ba'i mes spor lde sbar nas slob dpon gyi thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ kī la ya brjod cing thab la g.yas skor lan gsum byas la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing thab nang gi ting lo sbar/ de nas rtswa skam po gzhan gyis me kha gsos/ dgang blugs kha sbyar bas mar lan gsum phul/ gong gi sngags brjod/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam la g.yas khu tshur bcang ba las mdzub mo dang mthe bong bsgrengs bas blugs gzar bzung ba kha phub tu bcangs/ g.yon phyag rgya de nyid kha gyen du bstan pas dgang gzar bzung la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo g.yas pa'i lag mthil gyi 'og tu bzhag pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ agne ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis mar phul la/ mthar/

oṃ agne de ba bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyams chags gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shiṃnta ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar ba thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags sbyar ba/ pā dyaṃ/ nas/ shapta/ rol chen gyi bar gyis mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /skabs 'dir me pra brtags pa ni/ 'bum nag nas gsungs pa tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas brjod na/ rdo rje bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang / dung dkar 'dra ba bzang ba yin/ /gser ram nyi ma 'dra na bzang / /'brug sgra pi waṃ dri zhim dang / /du ba sngo zhing rtsa ba phra/ /rtse mo sbom na shin tu bzang / /thab shing shar byang 'gyel na bzang / /lho nub mtshams gzhan 'gyel na 'bring / /thal mdog nag na grib kyi rtags/ /dmar nag rim dang 'tshe ba'i rtags/ /snum dkar dri zhim nor phyugs bzang / /zhi la dkar dang rgyas la ser/ /dbang la dmar dang drag la nag /'di ni rang rang rtags su bzang / /'jam po gsum pa 'jam po yi/ /rtags rnams shes par bshad pa ste/ /mtha' ma'i las la ngan pa bsngags/ /rang rang rtags dang mi mthun na/ /bgegs dang bcas pa shes bya ste/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bo'i sngags rnams brjod bya zhing / /hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu gtor/ /gzhan yang dges pa rdo rje sogs/ /bla med rgyud ste gzhan dag nas/ /bzang rtags byung na nyer mchod lnga/ /'bul bar bshad kyang bar skabs 'dir/ /mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len la/

/mchod 'bul de ni mi mdzad do/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhī bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ oṃ agne ye swāhās mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhās til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zas mchog oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhās so ba/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhās 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swāhās nas/ oṃ badzra ghasmā ra ya swāhās gro/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhās sran ma/ oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe swāhās dur wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhās ku sha rnams phul la gong ltar sde tshan re re'i mthar spel tshig sbyar ro/ /thab nang du bsangs chu nas cung zad gtor la/ oṃ prokṣa naṃ añtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsangs gtor dang zhal bsil 'bul/ mar dgang blug gang thab nang du phul/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas sngar gyi me lha de nyid me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam zhing / me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ ༈ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni me kha gso phyir bud shing gsar pa phran bu brtsigs/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams kha gsos/ bsangs chu dang 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ oṃ ma hā shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ dharma dha tu badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ gis thab dang yo byad sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/

/hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ bhrūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ e a ka sha maṇḍal/ yaṃ wā yu maṇḍal/ baṃ u ta ka maṇḍal/ raṃ te dzwa maṇḍal/ laṃ pṛ thi wī maṇḍal/ raṃ rakta dzwa la maṇḍal/ keṃ ma hā kaṃ la su me ru maṇḍal/ bhrūm̐ bi shuddhe dzwa la maṇḍal/ e dri ko naṃ dzwa la badzra pra ka ra ṇa mi wardha maṇḍal/ bhrūm̐ da sha e ro tsakra maṇḍal/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yis byed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bhrūm̐ las rin chen sna lnga'i rang bzhin las/ /legs grub dwangs shing thogs med gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhi shel gser byu ru margad mdog /lte ba baiḍūrya yi rang bzhin can/ /steng 'og rtsig pa ka ba gdung la sogs/ /kun kyang rin chen lnga las legs grub cing / /'khor lo rin chen pad ral rdo rjes mtshan/ /rgya phub rtser rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sgo bzhi rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin la/ /rab mdzes rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /steng gi kha khyer rin chen du mas spras/ /bya 'dab las 'phyang gser gyi skud pas brgyus/ /rnga yab zla ba rdo rje phyed pa dang / /dar dpyangs sogs kyis brgyan pa'i do shal dang / /do shal phyed pas khor yug kun tu spras/ /steng du mda' yab padma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /thur du rin chen shar bus rnam par mdzes/ /'og gi stegs bur gzugs mas me long thogs/ /sgra mas gling bu dri mas dus chos thogs/

/ro mas zhal zas reg mas na bza' dang / /dbyings mas chos 'byung sgeg mas rdo rje dang / /phreng mas phreng ba glu mas pi wam̐ dang / /gar mas rdo rje me tog me tog snod/ /spos mas spos dang mar mes sgron me'i snod/ /rdza rnga rdza rnga chen mos rdza rngas mchod/ /gzhal yas dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /mu khyud rdo rje'i rwa bas rnam par spras/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur/ /gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu rab tu 'bar/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /shing me mchod rten chu bo grub pa brgyad/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang / /sha za smyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang / /mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro/ /ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkris/ /wa dang lce spyang khwa 'ug bya rgod dang / /kaṃ ka la sogs pheṃ sgra sgrogs pas gang / /dzaḥpa padma maṇḍal/ ma surya maṇḍal/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ brahma dzaḥ and+ri dzaḥ agne dzaḥ ya ma dzaḥ ni ri ti dzaḥ wa ru ṇa dzaḥ ba ya be dzaḥ ku be ra dzaḥ i shwa ra dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti dzaḥ ma traṃ dzaḥ ma traṃ dzaḥ gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ sgril ma bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa la dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī la kī la ya sarba bighnan bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur bsgril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa khams pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/

/stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang nas/ /dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /rakṣa zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng gi phyogs kyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ kā ra/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril/ /sprul pa phag dang rmig bu'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal/ /dbu gsum phyag drug༞ rdo rje sgeg mo༞ sprul pa stag dang bya rgod༞ oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ me yi mtshams kyi༞ khro bo chen po dbyug sngon can/ dbu gsum༞ rdo rje sder mo༞ sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog༞ oṃ badzra kro dha ya manta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho yi phyogs kyi༞ khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed/ /dbu gsum phyag༞ rdo rje dur khrod༞ sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i༞ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/

lho nub mtshams kyi༞ khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje gtun khung༞ sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i༞ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub kyi phyogs kyi༞ khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje g.yug tho༞ sprul pa byi la pu shud༞ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang mtshams kyi༞ khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje mda' snyems༞ sprul pa ce spyang khra yi mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang gi phyogs kyi༞ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje sgra mdzad༞ sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ༞ oṃ badzra kro dha tre lo kya bi dzra ya hūm̐ bindha bindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar mtshams kyi༞ khro chen khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje gsod ma༞ sprul pa dred dang sre mong༞ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og gi phyogs kyi༞ khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /dbu gsum༞ rdo rje rigs byed༞ sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo /khro chen yab rnams thams cad ni/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /mtha' mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ /yum rnams phyag g.yas dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu sogs/ /g.yas pas rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pas phur 'dzin ro steng bzhugs/ /khro bo yab yum phra thabs rnams kyi phyag mtshan sgrub thabs nas byung ba bzhin gsal btab/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badzra mā ra ni hūm̐ hoḥ shar sgor pu shud mgo can ni/ /mdog dkar 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu bsnams/ /lho sgor bya rog mgo can ni/ /mdog ser 'ching ba'i zhags pa bsnams/ /nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can ni/

/mdog dmar sdom byed lcags sgrogs bsnams/ /byang sgor khra yi mgo can ni/ /ljang khu mnyes byed dril bu bsnams/ /khro chen 'khor bcas yab yum rnams/ /rgyan sogs yab yum tshul bzhin te/ /kun kyang rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra yo ge shwa ri aṣṭa biṃ sha ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shrī ghraṃ karma ka ra mā ra se na pra mardha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim khor yug na/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis sogs/ / 'di'i sogs khongs su ni gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi bstan ma bcu gnyis gying chen bco brgyad gying chen 'bum sde dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti skyes bu gsum bse lcags dung gsum dam can rdor legs sogs 'khod par bsam/ dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur/ lha thams cad las 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam/ ༈ /zhes pas dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ spro na spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes spyan drangs pas rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur byon par bsam/

gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs su bshad pa ltar/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ni/ sogs sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang du byas par bsam/ rgyas 'debs pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par pa aḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yig 'bru gsum gyi rnam par byung ba lha thams cad gnas gsum du gnyis su med par thim/ ces brjod cing / nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod dbang bskur ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rang bzhin gyis zhugs pa'i khro bo rigs lnga la gsol ba btab ste thal mo sbyar te/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces pas gsol ba btab pas khro bo rigs lngas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhi shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhi shwa ri trām̐/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhi shwa ri hrī/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥ zhes dbang bskur bas gtso bo yab yum khro bo bcu yab yum/ phra thabs sgo ma rnams la khro bo rigs lnga tshar re re/ dam can dbang phyug ma rnams la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ gong byon zan skabs kyi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ kī la ya/ lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i mar dgang blug bdun/ agne'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa gsum gyis 'bul/ slar yang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin gyi brlabs pa'i rjes su/

ḍā dril bzung la/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgras/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /ḍā dril rol chen bya zhing / rang gi snying kha nas sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje dril bu 'gying pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba thogs pa/ glu ma dmar mo pi wang bsgreng ba/ gar ma ljang khu rdor dril thogs nas gar byed pa/ spos ma dkar mo dri bzang gi spos phor thogs pa/ me tog ma ser mo mdzes pa'i me tog thogs pa/ mar me ma dmar mo 'od gsal gyi mar me 'dzin pa/ dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung phor thogs pa rnams kyi lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa dang / gzhan yang nyer mchod ni/ puṣpe ma dkar mo me tog thogs pa/ spos ma dud khas spos snod/ sgron ma dmar mo snang gsal/ dri ma ljang khus dri chab/ ro ma dmar mos zhal zas te nyer mchod dang / gzhan yang rdza rnga pi waṃ gling bu pheg rdobs sil snyan rol mo rnga bo che/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams bkang nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā lya trāṃ/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nīrti āḥ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃḥ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke aḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ mdun gyi nang mchod kyi khebs bsal/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dbus nas blangs la/

dmigs pa ni g.yon pa'i mthe bong hrīḥlas rta mgrin/ srin lag a las phag mor bsams pa yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas mchod pa'i lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med par sprul te/ de yang thab khung gi steng gi nam mkhar chos sku kun tu bzang po sogs brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma/ bar gyi cha la rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs zhi ba bcu gcig rtsa gnyis/ buddha he ru ka sogs khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad thab khung gi nang na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs dang / gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad na bar mtshams med par sangs rgyas byang sems grub pa rig 'dzin chos skyong nor lha phyogs skyong gzhi bdag 'byung po la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa thams cad bdud rtsis mnyes par bsams la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing / ༈ /rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga sogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol zhing / /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa thams cad dang / /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro bo yab yum bcu/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang /

/sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur pa'i lha/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rje cher dgongs༞ /ma hā pañtsa༞ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /gegs chen bco brgyad geng phreng 'bum sde dang / dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la/ rnam dag༞ /thugs rje༞ /ma hā༞ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang / /bswe yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rje༞ /ma hā༞ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi༞ /chos sku kun tu bzang po'i༞ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i༞ /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas༞ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ /khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du khā hi/ rang la dngos grub blangs pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdub 'tshob pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod cing lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su thig le byas la/ kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod do/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi thugs kha nas yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la sogs gtso 'khor rnams kyi yum gyi rang bzhin gyi rig ma dpag tu med pa sprul nas de dag gis lha tshogs thams cad la 'khyud pa'i mchod pa 'bul bar bsam zhing / 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor bas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /padmo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par mchod/ /sa mā ya hoḥ sa mā ya satwaṃḥ ra go a nu rā ga ya mi bo tsitta/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul thams cad ka dag de kho na nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag la/ mnyam pa'i grub rdzas chen mo ni/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' ba btung ba bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/

/dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra a be sha ya/ a be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ma hā su kha pra tītstsha hāoḥ pra ti gṛhna khā hiḥ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i khro bcu phra thabs/ sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ de dag gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas gnas pa'i gdug pa can gyi zhing bcu tshang zhing bsgral bar 'os pa thams cad kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcing / mtshon cha dpag tu med pas bsdigs shing bkug nas rang nyid mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i mdun du gnam lcags kyi 'brub khung du bcug te bsgral ba'i las bya bar bsam zhing / dril bu drag tu dkrol rdo rje gsor zhing gzhan yang rol mo'i sgra drag po sna tshogs tshom rngams dang bcas/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs/ /pho nya chen po'i dus la babs/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la༞ /sa bdag chen mo'i dus la༞ /khyi yi gdong can༞ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs/ /byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni de bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ/ satwambha nan/ mo haṃ gha ta ya/ bha ga wan/ hrīḥṣṭi wiṣṭi badzra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bighnān/ badzra kī li kī la ya phaṭa/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bsgral ba'i mchod pa'o/

/rakta'i mchod pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying khrag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil ba lha rnams kyis thod skyogs su bcus nas zhal du gsol bar bsam zhing / ḍā dril dang bcas/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā maṃ sa rakta sa mu dra kha kha khā hi khā hi hri da ya pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rakta'i mchod pa'o/ /khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ bsgral ma thag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi lus gzugs khams/ ngag 'dod khams/ yid gzugs med khams kyi rang bzhin can bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyis mchod par bsam pa/ ḍā dril gyi mu nas/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /'khor ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams du gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā ru dhi ra khā hi/ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā ma ta khā hi/ ma hā asti khā hi/ khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa'o/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i byin rlabs kyi skabs su byin gyis brlab pa'i dpal chen po'i gtor ma de nyid ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin la/ rnam pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i phung po chen por bsam/ thab nang gi lha thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad gsol bar bsam la/ ḍā dril gyi mu nas/

bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ ba liṃ ta/ pra tītstsha hoḥgṛhna khā hi/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas ḍā ma ru bzhag la rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang dril bu mtshams mtshams su dkrol la bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ sgeg cing dpa' dang mi sdug tshul ston gyis/ /rgod dang gshed dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / /snying rjes rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /gar dgus rol mdzad rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /e ka dza ṭī gu hye gsang ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang smig bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil pa sgra mdzad seng ge pha waṃ mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dred dang sre mong mgo /stobs chen rigs byed dom dang byi ba'i mgo /gnod sbyin 'jig ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dngos grub mchog stsol ye shes chen po'i lha/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can sogs/ /phrin las bzhi bsgrub dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /rig sngags khro bcu sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la bstod/ /bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i go rim bzhin la sngags rnams kī ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/

'bul yul kyang / yam shing gi me 'od 'bar ba la bzhu ba'i rdzas rnams lha thams cad kyi zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo/ ༈ /bzhi pa bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi sbyin sreg gi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su bsnyen tshad 'bum grangs kyi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gi grangs 'dzin dgos pas/ de yang sdig pa zhi ba dang gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa gso ba'i phyir til lam yungs dkar gang rung la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin cing / stong ra can la sogs pa'i mthar grangs 'dzin gyi til yungs gang rung thab nang du thog mar phul/ de nas yam shing nas ku sha'i bar gyi rdzas rnams kī la ya spel tshig dang bcas pas tshar bcu gcig phul/ yang sngar bzhin til yungs la grangs bzung de 'dra ba lan bcu gcig phul ba'i mtha' mar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs bdun spel tshig dang bcas pa lan gsum 'bul/ de nas/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung sogs nang mchod/ sgeg cing sogs bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi rjes su yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor chog rnams bya ba yin/ yang bsnyen pa sogs ma yin zhing rang dang gzhan gyi don du bar chad la sogs pa zhi ba'i phyir 'phral la sbyin sreg brtsams pa rnams la ni bsnyen pa'i bcu cha lta bu'i grangs 'dzin thub na rab dang / de min yang da lta phyag len la mdzad pa ltar kī la ya kho nas thog mar yam shing rkyang pa brgya rtsa phul ba'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pas phul/ 'di la thog mar gcig gnyis shig dang mtshams mtshams re gnyis ma gtogs dngos su mi 'bul zhing stangs ka byas la phyogs gcig tu gsal zhing rim gyi me kha gso/ de nas mar nas bzung ste ku sha'i bar rdzas so so nas brgya rtsa re phul zhing mthar spel tshig sbyar/ de thams cad phul ba'i rjes su mar dgang blugs bdun spel tshig dang bcas pa lan gsum 'bul/

sbyin bdag lta bu dngos su nye skor na yod na/ de'i mthe bong dang blugs gzar lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di 'bul zhing / spel tshig kyang / sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / skye ba 'dir yang lan chags shing sha 'khon du gnyer ba'i mi dang mi ma yin gyi gdug rtsub kyis tshe dang srog la rgol ba sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang gong du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /da ni zhar byung yi dam chos skyong sogs la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang rang gi phyag len ltar go rim bzhin phul ba'i rjes su bskang ba'ang rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gyi gtor 'bul yan dang / yang sbyin sreg thun bcad lta bu yin na thun gong ma rnams la mchod bstod kyi rjes su gtor ma rnams/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ rang gi thugs kha nas raṃ dmar po spros pa'i mes gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsreg sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ'i rjes su kyai rdor lta bu la 'bul na/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e/ sogs gtor chog bzhin/ slar yang byin rlabs dran par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sogs/ de rjes/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi sogs gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor ma phul/ dkar bdud lcam dral gyi gtor ma'ang byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su padma nyi zla'i gdan la sogs/ gtor mgron bskyed ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur dam la bzhag gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ phrin las gzhol/ phur srung gi gtor ma'ang byin gyis brlabs/ spyan drangs gtor ma phul/ sman raka gi mchod phrin gzhol/

mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor gzhi bdag rnams la'ang gtor ma 'bul lo/ /'di rnams rang rang gi phyag len la yod na de dag nang bzhin med tshe sa lo'i gsung la sngags 'chang chen pos zin bris mdzad pa'i gtor chog chen mo nang bzhin bya/ gtor bsngo rnams kyi rjes su bstod pa'ang rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'am/ yang na sa lo'i gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar mgon po lha mo zhal rnams kyi sngags thung brjod/ bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung ma/ mgon po/ lha mo/ zhal/ las mkhan rnams la shlau ka re re/ de rjes phrin bcol gyi tshig khyad par dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung rnams/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i/ spyan sngar khas blangs de bzhin du/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang / /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba dang / /sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /bsam pa thams cad sgrub pa dang / /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /kyis dkar mo ba dang / hūm̐/ sngon tshe bdud kun gyi ni bdag po ste/ /shin tu mi bzad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi /spyan sngar khas blangs bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod/ /kyis bdud rgyal phyag len gyi khrigs la/ bdud rta bra nag sogs bran bdud kyi bstod pa'ang mdzad mod/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /phur srung la/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam can nag mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis/ /rnam lnga rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma sring mdza' mo'i tshul gyis grogs mdzod cig /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam/ de nas dngos grub blang ba/ bzod pa gsol ba/ ye shes pa gshegs gsol/

me lha lhag ma'i mchod pa/ bsngo smon shis brjod rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba yin cing / dgong thun lta bu zhig la/ gong du bshad pa ltar bskang ba'i gtor 'bul yan grub par byas na/ 'byor na tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor ba mchod gtor rnams kyi mdun du bshams/ nang mchod kyis sbyong / rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pa tshogs kyi snod la reg pas/ sogs nas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs ltar las/ 'don pa cung zad bsgyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ byin rlabs ḍā dril gsil ba'am spro na phyag len la mdzad pa ltar rnga rdung dang bcas tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa ni/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/ /rol mo dang bcas/ oṃ e hya hi bha ga wan/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ri tri shye hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ e a ra li hrīṃ hrīṃ/ zhes brjod pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsam/ tshogs 'bul ba ni thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du tshogs rdzas rnams kyi phud nas bsdus la/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yis mchod pas yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yis mchod pas tshig par mchod/ /ro yi mchod pas bde mchog ldan/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bla na med/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyas par 'bul/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/

/zhes brjod la mchod g.yog pas tshogs phud rnams gtor ma'i drung du bzhag tshogs chang phud phor gyi nang du blugs/ zho dang tshod ma sogs yod na'ang des rigs 'gre/ dpon g.yog rnams kyis rol mo dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhūpaṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha hoḥ gṛhna khā hiḥ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa'o/ /tshogs bar pa bshags pa'i mchod pa ni/ skye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs dang khyad par tshe 'dir yang gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la nyams chag 'khrul ci mchis pa thams cad 'gyod sems drag po'i sgo nas bshags par bya'o snyam pas rnga brdung dang bcas/ lus kyis sdig pa bgyis pa mngon sum du/ /ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod/ /sems kyis blo nor log par sems la sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / /de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i dam can rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsam na brlag par mdzad/ /chag nyams 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ /mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'di rnams la rnga brdung rol mo dkrol ba sogs 'dir bshad pa ni sa skya rang gi phyag len dang bstun pa yin cing / gzhan du na gong spyan 'dren gyi skabs su ḍā dril sogs mdzad tshe 'og ma rnams la'ang de bzhin tu nges par gnang dgos te/ phur pa 'di ni gzhi thams cad rnying ma'i phyag len la ltos pas ḍā dril sogs mdzad pa'ang rnying ma ba rnams spros pa che bas so/ /gang ltar sbyin sreg zhag sgril nas mdzad tshe nyin dang po rnams bshags pa grub 'phral spyi bstab kyi gtor ma phul/ mjug chog rnams 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/

nyin tha ma'i tshe bshags pa grub nas dgra bgegs kyi liṅga lcags snod sogs su bshams pa slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ e raṃ/ e raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ dzaḥ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur bu/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bka' sdod chos skyong / ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la gzugs dang liṅga 'di la mchis par gyur cig ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyag rgya de nyid thog mar g.yas nas bskor zhing liṅga'i steng du phab la de bzhin du g.yon/ dbus rnams nas bskor zhing phab la sngags ni/ kī la ya dang / sarba sha truṃ nā sha ya dzambha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya/ bandha ya/ mā ra ya/ zhes brjod la sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghanḍe hoḥ zhes brjod cing 'ching sdom gyi las mdzad par bsam/

slar yang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las/ mdzub mo gnyis yang yang rang gi snying kha'i thad du bkug pa lha dbye'i phyag rgya dang / pañtsa kandhaṃ de wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ dha tu aṣṭaṃ da sha de wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ dwa de sha ya ta nan de wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ sarba de wa rakṣa a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pa lha dbye/ 'dir dgug gzhug tshar gcig gis chog go /de rnams kyi dmigs pa rgyas pa 'og drag po'i sbyin sreg gi skabs su rgyas par 'byung ba der blta bar bya'o/ /de nas phur pa bzung la 'chams tshul dang bcas/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la༞ /pho nya chen po'i༞ /bdag nyid chen mo'i༞ /sa bdag rgyal mo'i༞ /khyi yi gdong can༞ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs/ / 'di ni sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar yin/ dam tshig chen po yongs rdzogs brjod kyang khyad par med do/ /zhes brjod cing 'chams tshul rol mo drag tu brdung zhing phur pa rang gi gnas gsum du bsgril/ liṅga'i snying khar btab/ kī la ya dang / oṃ laṃ/ sogs brjod cing rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du bskyal/ phur skor dmigs pa rgyas pa 'og drag po'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas ral gri sogs kyis ling ro dum bur gtub/ slob dpon gyis thogs la phyi nang gsang ba ma bya/ ling ro gtor ma la 'bul/ de nas spyi btab kyis gtor ma phul ba'i rjes su dpal chen po'i pham lhag za ba'i dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis skyong ba ni/ hoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dpal chen po'i pham 'bags las nos te rnal 'byor pa'i sdong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi dang / dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi rnams sngon gyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir 'dus shig

ḍā ki ni hūm̐ dzaḥ e a ra li hrīṃ hrīṃ/ zhes brjod la khyung gshog zil gnon gyi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bskyal ba'i thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug pa'o/ /de nas rol dbyangs dang bcas/ bhyoḥ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs bstan ma skyong ba rnams/ /'dir byon dam dgongs phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bdud mo chen mo mched bzhi dang / /kha rag khyung btsun la sogs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen mo mched bzhi dang / /kong btsun de mo la sogs pa'i/ /sman btsun chen mo mched bzhi rnams/ /bran g.yog mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog pa dang / /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /zhes brjod cing bstan ma bskyangs la gtor ma 'bul lo/ /'di rnams la chos rje bla ma sogs sngon byon gyi gong ma dag gi phyag len la dpal chen mo'i gtor ma'i smad bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid kyis bstan ma skyong bar mdzad la/ sngags 'chang rgya gar bas rnying ma'i phyag len gyis kha bskangs te bstan ma'i gtor ma khang bzang gru bzhi/ dkar gtor zlum po/ gru gsum gnyis dmar rtsi dang g.yas gcus nag rtsis byugs pa'i gtor ma bzang po de'i steng du bzhag cing rgyan gyis spras la de nyid sger du 'bul bar mdzad kyang / da lta phyag len la rgyas pa'i phyogs la gtor ma sger bsham dang / bsdus pa la dpal chen gyi gtor mas 'thus par mdzad pas 'dir yang 'byor na bsham rung dang ma 'byor tshe dpal gtor gyis 'thus par byas pas chad pa'i skyon med/ gzhan mjug chog rnams 'dra ba las/ nyin snga ma rnams su lhag ma bsags pa snod gcig tu spung la spos btsugs chang gis sbran te bkra shis kyi gong du slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dpag yas las/ /grub pa gsang ba 'bar ma'i tshogs/ /tshur gshegs gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rdo rje lcam dral srung ba dang / /rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas lhag ma za ba'i bye brag pho nya/ phra men 'bar ma/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams mdun du byon nas mchod pa dang dmar gyi arghaṃ sbrengs pa bzhes par bsam la/ de nas rdo rje 'gros kyis phyir nur ba'i mos pa byas la/ dpal gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs shing mchod pa ni/ dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum gyi/ /pho nya 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /de yi bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /phyogs su dag nas gshegs su gsol/ / 'di gsung rgyun 'ga' zhig la mi gsung bar/ phyogs bcu dag nas gshegs su gsol gyi rjes su gzhan yang phra men tshogs dang zhes sbrel ba yin 'dug na'ang / sngon gyi gsung rgyun rnying ma yin min slar dpyad par bya'o/ /de ni 'phros don no/ /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam ji dgongs te/ mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phra men tshogs dang bcas/ 'bar ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ trāṃ/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥ oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥ zhes pa gtso bo brgyad la gtor ma sbyin la/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya lhag ma'i gtor ma la ston pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/

mthe bong dang gung mo rtse sbyar/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung 'bar ba ltar byas la kha bkru 'debs tshul dang / oṃ u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bakṣa si swāhā/ de nas bsngo ba ni/ khro rgyal dpal gyi pho nya mo/ /ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi/ /dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs shing / /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lhag ma'i gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi bdag bskyed pa/ thab khung rdzas yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi sbyin sreg gis dbye ba bstan pa/ zhar byung 'phros don dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rab dkar thab khung nang du byin za'i me/ /'bar ba'i khrod du 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /bsreg rdzas phul bas gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog zhi/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la'ang gsum ste/ dngos grub blangs shing nongs pa bzod gsol te/ ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa bsdu ba/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod cing gtor 'bul 'dod don zhu zhing gshegs gsol lhag chad kha bskang ba bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /dang po dngos grub blangs shing nongs pa bzod gsol yi dam gshegs bsdu bya ba ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pas/ /thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs la/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs sgrol ba dang /

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsams la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thab kyi thal ba nas blangs la dpral bar reg go /gnyis pa me lha lhag mas mchod cing gtor ma btang / 'dod don zhu gshegs gsol lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ thab khung du mar dgang blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod la/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ sngar bsreg rdzas kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar rdzas rnams so so'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun re phul ba'i mthar/ mar gyi gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma btang ba ni/ thab kyi shar lhor dkar gtor zlum po zhig nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgyal mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yon pa mnyam bzhag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ agne ya sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ adyā nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod gong bzhin/ bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang sogs kyi rjes su/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/

/thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gundhi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yangs la sim/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes brjod 'dod don zhu ba ni dril bu gsum brdung du dkrol la/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don zhu/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bsang chu nas thab nang du gtor la/ gsang gtor dang zhal bsil 'bul bar bsams la/ oṃ prakṣo naṃ añtsa ma naṃ pā dyaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ sngar gyi spyan 'dren gyi phyag rgya rna ba gnyis kyi drung nas phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye a ni gatstsha/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ oṃ badzra sa twa sogs yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang / go cha bsgo ba ni/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra sogs brjod/ gsum pa bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas par brjod pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /ces dang gzhan yang bla med kyi rgyud sde gzhan nas 'byung ba'i/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/

/sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya/ skabs 'dir gong du bshad pa'i lhag ma btang / de nas/ mtshungs med bla ma sogs bkra shis kyang ci shes blo dang bstun par byed do/ /de rnams ni sgrub thabs bsdus pa rkyang pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na/ tshogs rgyas pa lhag ma rgyas pa/ bstan skyong rgyas pa/ mjug chog ni mi 'dra ba rnams sgrub thabs nyid nas 'byung ba ltar ma 'dres par nyams su blang ngo / /'dir ni gnas skabs kyi 'dod don sgrub pa'i phyir nyin gcig gnyis sogs kyis sbyin sreg gi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ bsnyen pa sogs kyi sbyin sreg zhib pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes 'khrul zad kyi skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga phrin las lhun grub bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings mthon po nas/ /mdzad bzang sbyin sreg nyi ma 'di shar tshe/ /bar chad mi mthun stug po'i mun nag 'bum/ /sa 'og rim pa bdun du bros min nam/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /da ni rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg la yang don gsum ste sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ /sngon 'gro la'ang gsum ste/ thab khung bshad pa/ rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa/ rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang kha blta phyogs dus bshad pa'o/ /dang po thab khung ni/ gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /phongs par gyur pa'i 'gro gang la/ /dkyil 'khor rgya ru khru gang la/ /ser po rdzas kyis byugs par bya/ /zhes pa dang / bsreg 'phyongs las/ gru bzhi phrin las rgyas pa'i haṃ/ /gsang ba'i yum bzhi kha la rtsig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sa stegs gru bzhir rgyar khru do mtho gang sor bzhi yod pa/

dpangs su mtho gang pa gser dang 'byor tshe kha che gur gum byugs shing / khod snyoms pa'i khar btsag dmar gyis thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab/ de'i dbus su stegs byas la shar nas bzung phyogs bzhir khru re bzhag pa'i khru bzhir btab pas phyogs gnyis gnyis bsdoms pa'i khru do re 'byung ba ni/ thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi nas sor brgyad 'byor ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa kha khyer dang / de'i phyir yang sor brgyad kyis sa gru bzhir btab pa mu ran no/ / tshad 'di gnas khang chung ba sogs su bskul rung bar bsam ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi thab bzhi'o/ /tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzoms pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi legs par sbrel nas gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir/ rdo rje rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i gsham nas zla phyed kyis spras pa/ mu ran la nor bu zlum po me ris kyis brgyan pa phyogs mtshams rnams su che ba gsum gsum byas pa'i bar thams cad chung bas sbrel bas gru bzhir bskor/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i gong gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba dang / phyi'i sum gnyis la 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams bya/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na gzhi ser po bcad dmar po rin po che'i phreng ba sna tshogs zla phyed rdo rje dkar po rdo rje dmar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud sngon po bya'o/ /de'i nang du tshon spung bkod pa ni gong zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar bya zhing / 'on kyang slob dpon zhal byang du blta ba'i dbang du byas nas 'jig rten pa'i lho drang po'i rtsibs g.yas par hūm̐ mdzad/ 'jig rten pa'i byang drang po'i rtsibs g.yas par rta mgrin bya/ de bzhin du shar gyi sgo ma'i tshom bu'ang 'jig rten pa'i lho drang por bya/ gzhan thams cad zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya ba'i thab bshad pa'o/

/gnyis pa rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa ni/ gsang rgyud las/ bud shing ser po gang dang gang / /sboms su chag gang chur khru gang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bud shing mdog ser ba snum dang bcas pa ste me thang shing lta bu'am/ mdog gi sgo nas nges pa med pas shing mar khu can kham star la sogs pa ring thung khru gang gi tshad/ zheng du sor gang sor do mtho gang gang rigs skabs dang sbyar ba'i rtsa rtser mar khu kha che zho byugs pa'i thab khung brtsigs pa dang / 'bul ba'i yam shing gnyis ka bya ba'am yang na rtsig shing dgon pa'i ba yi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa kha khyer gyi steng la dpangs su khru gang gru bzhir brtsigs shing yam shing la gong gi mar khu can gyi shing gang rung 'bul ba'o/ /gzhan yang rang gi g.yas thabs kyi g.yon nas shing stegs la sogs pa'i khar 'byor na gser/ lcug ma/ ra gan la sogs pa'i ting ser por rdzas kyi dang por/ mar bzang / zho/ mngar gsum/ kha che rnams zan gyis sbrus pa'i zas mchog de nas kha che sogs rdzas ser pos kha bsgyur ba'i/ dur ba/ sran ma/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ so ba/ til/ ku sha rnams sgrig rim bzhin bshams/ lcug ma la sogs pa'i snod ser por mar khu yung ba la sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ rdzas de thams cad kha gso ba'i chas dang bcas pa/ rang gi g.yon thabs kyi g.yas nas gser sogs kyi ting ser po gang rung gi nang du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod kha ches kha dog bsgyur ba/ khyad par zhal zas mar gyis sbrus pa la/ yung ba mar la sbyar bas byugs pa rang dang thab kyi bar du/ me yi dug sel ba'i me yol sa phag las sa dkar gyi byugs pa la gangs ri la wam̐ yig dang chu ris rnams bya/ 'di zhi rgyas dbang drag las thams cad pa dang bcas pa la kha dog dkar po kho na bya ba yin te/ gangs ri'i kha dog gzhan du mi snang ba'i phyir dang / bsgom don la 'jig rten pa'i me lha spyan 'dren gyi skabs su de'i 'khor gdug pa can gyis sgrub pa po la bar chad kyi gdug rtsub ston pas de zhi ba'i phyir me yol de nyid ri bo'i gangs su bsgom pas dug thams cad sel nus shing /

yang me yol med pa'i phyogs la slob dpon a bha ya'i dgongs pa ltar me lha spyan 'dren grub 'phral yungs dkar gyis brab cing khro bo'i sngags brjod pas phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad bsrung bar bya dgos kyang da ltar phyag len la snga ma nyid mdzad do/ /de'i rgyab tu lcog rtse'i khar rdor dril bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba bzhag pa dang / gzhan yang ḍā ma ru nang mchod 'thor nas/ sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gi phyogs yin na sras mchog gi phur pa lnga'am gcig kyang bshams/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba'i chu dang ku sha'i chun po brgyad spor lde la sogs pa dang / dpal gtor sman raka la sogs pa thams cad gong zhi ba'i skabs ltar ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /gsum pa rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa kha lta phyogs dus bshad pa ni/ de yang 'dir rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa'i rgyan ni/ spos shel gser la sogs pa'i phreng ba 'byor ba lag tu bzung / stan ser por dpangs mtho ba la gos ser por brgyan te rkang pa g.yas cung zad phyir brkyangs pa rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ bsam pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor la sogs pa rgyas par byas la bdag gzhan gyi don grub bo snyam pas/ kha byang du bltas te/ dus rab ston zla ra ba'i tho rangs bca' ba'am/ yang na zla ba gang rung gi tho rangs nas mgo brtsams par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi thab khung rdzas dang yo byad rgyab dang 'dug stangs la sogs pa sngon 'gro ma lus pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rgyas pa'i cha/ /yongs su bskul phyir rten 'brel phun tshogs rdzas/ /rin chen gser gyi mdog can bshams pa yis/ /tshe dang bsod nams gong du cis mi 'phel/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gsum ste/ bdag bskyed pa rdzas dang yo byad thab khung byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te/

mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ zhar byung 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung ngam/ yang na stabs bde ba'i phyir/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin nyams su blangs te mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar rdzogs par bsgom pa ni bdag bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang yo byad thab khung byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ thog mar bsang chu la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa rnams zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin bya/ de nas chu de nyid kyis thab khung dang bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas rnams la gtor te/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ sprin gyi phung po lta bu dang / zhes pa'i bar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin las/ bsreg rdzas gtsang zhing snum bag dang ldan pa tshe dang bsod nams dpal thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li nas/ ku ru ku ru bar zhi ba ltar byin gyis brlab pas mthu ldan gyi rdzas su gyur par bsam/ de nas slar yang bsangs chus thab khung la gtor te/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi rgyar khru do zabs su khru gang kha khyer ram mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs pa ni/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro zhing 'du ba/

'gying bag dang bcas pas ra'i steng na gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bgrang phreng ser po dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che la ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sma ra'i ag tshom can drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las kyi bar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ de nas ku sha 'bul ba ni/ zhi ba bzhin/ skabs 'dir sbor ba'i me tog rjes su rigs kyi me'am/ shing snum can gtsub pa las byung ba dang / phyug po'am dge 'dun gyi g.yos khang gi mes spor lde sbar la sngags brjod cing bskor ba ting lo sbar ba me kha gso ba mar dgang blugs 'bul ba rnams las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dgang blugs rin po che'i phyag rgyas bzung ba ste/ de yang lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcang ba las mthe bong dang mdzub mo rtse sbyar ba'i bar nas dgang blugs bzung ba'o/ /de bas me lha'i byon zan 'bul ba'i spel tshig yan zhi ba dang 'dra bas las/ spel tshig ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ swāhā/ zhes brtags/ de nas phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams zhi ba bzhin/ me pra brtags pa'i skabs su khyad par me mdangs ser zhing rin po che 'dra na 'bar na mchog tu bzang ngo / /gzhan bzang ngan gyi rtags thams cad zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa bzhin brtags par bya'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ mar khu can gyi shing gang rung gi yam shing de nyid lag tu bzung la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes bdun phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sogs gong gi spel tshig sbyar ba bdun gyis phul/ de bzhin du mar la/ agne/ zas mchog la/ sarba paṃ pa de/

dur ba la/ ā yuḥṣe/ sran ma la/ ma hā ba la/ 'bras la/ badzra puṣṭa/ nas la/ mahā be ga gro la/ badzra ghasma rī/ so ba la/ badzra bi dza ya/ til la/ sarba pā paṃ/ ku sha la/ a pra ti ha ta/ sogs de thams cad la lan bdun bdun phul ba'i mthar/ gong gi spel tshig sbyar bas phul/ de nas bsang gtor dang mar gyis dgang blugs phul te/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur gyi bar zhi ba'i byin sreg bzhin brjod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bud shing rnams kha gsos/ bsang chu gtor la/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ ma hā shun+yā ta sa sbyangs/ rdo rje sngon po phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar zhi ba sor bzhag 'on kyang lha so so'i sku mdog la cung zad ser ba 'gying bag dang bcas shing 'od zer ser po spro bsdu'i sgo nas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ byon zan spel tshig can 'bul ba/ phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ bsgral mchod rakta'i mchod pa/ khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar bya/ yam shing nas ku sha'i bar gyi bsreg rdzas thams cad so so nas brgya rtsa brgyad mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul/ zhar las byung ba'i 'phros don ni/ bsnyen pa'i mjug lta bu la byed na/ thun bcad kyi bcu cha'i grangs kyi sbyin sreg zhi ba'i skabs ltar 'bul ba'am/ yang na gong bkod bzhin nyin gcig la gcig gi dbang du byas na brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ de nas gang ba'i sbyin sreg bdun gsum gyi mthar spel tshig bcas phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams zhi ba'i skabs ltar bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'ang zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar rgyas bsdus dbye ba skabs bstun bzhin bya zhing /
