tshogs kyang tshogs mchod bshags mchod/ bsgral mchod kyang bya/ bstan ma bskyangs/ thun gtor 'bul ba sogs thams cad kyang zhi ba bzhin no/ /de rnams kyang sbyin sreg zhag sbrel dang / thun bcad lta bu yin na thab kho na la bya'o/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi bdag bskyed pa thab khung rdzas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs pa mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba zhar byung 'phros don dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /rin chen gser gyi kha dog thab khung dbus/ /tshe dang bsod nams stobs bskyed 'bar ba'i me/ /gzi mdangs gsal ba'i khrod du lha tshogs rnams/ /spyan drangs mchod pas tshe bsod cis mi rgyas/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa la mjug gi bya ba la yang gsum ste/ dngos grub blangs shing lhag chad kha bskang te bzod pa gsol ba/ dam ye gshegs bsdu me lha lhag mas mchod cing / gtor 'bul mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhu zhing gshegs su gsol ba/ lhag chad kha bskang te bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis mjug bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po dngos grub blangs shing lhag chad kha bskang te bzod par gsol ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gnyis pa dam ye gshegs pa bsdu/ me lha lhag mas mchod cing gtor 'bul mchod bstod gshegs su gsol ba ni mar dgang blugs gang thab nang du blugs la/ dzwa la'i sngags brjod pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur pa la bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams lan bdun re phul ba'i mthar/ gong gi spel tshig dang bcas pa gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun spel tshig dang bcas phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor 'bul ni/ me lha'i gtor ma mar gyis sbrus pa zlum po yung bas byugs pa thab kyi shar lhor bzhag pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/

badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i sogs nas mtshan sngags la/ a kā ro btags pa bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rgyas pas bstod/ 'dod don zhu ba ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ prokṣa ṇaṃ sogs kyis bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gi don dang / sogs nas/ ya hi gatstsha/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas me lha gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang zhing / go bsgo ba bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis bya ba ni/ shrī badzra ku mā ra/ sogs kyis go bsgo/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci shes/ lhag gtor btang / mtshungs med bla ma sogs kyis bkra shis kyi mtha' brten par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i lag len ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ dpag yas skye dgu'i bsod nams nyer 'tsho las/ /legs 'ongs 'dod dgu'i dpal ster me shel dbang / /mkha' khyab 'od zer 'gog med spro bzhin du/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i tshal skyong deng 'dir shar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa dbang gi sbyin sreg la yang gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ /sngon 'gro la yang gnyis/ thab khung rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa/ rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang kha blta phyogs dus bshad pa'o/ /dang po thab khung ni gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams nas/ /chags par gyur pa'i 'gro gang la/ /dbang gi las la sbyar ba bya/ /zla gam dmar po'i dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /rgya la sor ni nyi shu la/ /kha la sor bcu 'bri bar bya/ /phyi rol lcags kyu zhags pas brgyan/ /zhes dang / bsreg 'phyongs las/ zla gam dmar po dbang gi haṃ/

/stong gsum yum gyi mkha' la rtsig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sa stegs gru bzhi khod snyoms pa'i sar btsag dang 'byor tshe tsandan dmar pos byugs/ sa dkar gyis sbags pa'i thig skud kyis thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i dbus nas gsum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su rtsibs bcu'i lte ba dang / phyi'i sum gnyis la 'khor lo rtsib bcu pa rnams bya/ de'i phyir thab che chung gi tshad dang mthun par mu khyud gnyis rim bskor bas khru gang 'byung zhing / thab kyi rgyab khru gang gi tshad yin pas 'khor lo'i lte bar srad bu bzung la mu khyud phyi ma dang nas gang tsam gyis ma reg pa shar lho'i zur thig nas g.yas bskor du bskor la/ byang shar gyi zur thig steng du bzhag de nas sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa sngar bzhin bskor bas kha khyer/ slar yang sor bzhi sngar bzhin bskor bas mu ran 'byung zhing / so so'i rtse thig nas phred la drang por btab pas zla gam gyi dbyibs su bya/ de rnams kyi phyir sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa stegs bu/ de nas sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa cha ga gru bzhir btab pa cha ga gru bzhir 'byung ba ni stegs bu'i dpangs tshad yin la/ 'on kyang dbang gi thab 'di zla gam gyi khyad ma gtogs zhi ba kho na ltar bya/ zhes yig cha rnams las gsungs pas na stegs bu'i dpangs tshad kyang de ltar du byas pa yin la/ stegs bu gru bzhi 'di grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje spyi dang mthun par bya zhing / rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na gzhi thams cad dmar po/ bcad dkar po/ 'khor lo ser po/ mu khyud ljang khu/ zla phyed rdo rje dkar po/ lcags kyu'i yu ba dmar po/ lcags kyu sngon po/ zhags pa dmar po la lung lcags kyu nag po bya'o/ /mu ran la rgyud las/ phyi rol lcags kyu zhags pas brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas phyogs rnams su rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu'i kha phyir bstan pa/

mtshams rnams su lcags kyus brgyan pa'i zhags pa'i ri mo bya ba ni thab khung bshad pa'o/ /rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa ni/ bud shing ngam yam shing 'bras bu can ro mngar ba'am skyur ba gang rung la ring thung gi tshad mtho gang ste/ rgyud las/ sboms su chags gang chur sor gang zhes gsungs pa ltar shing de nyid kyi thab khung zla gam gyi dbyibs su rtsig pa'am/ yang na rgyas pa ltar/ dgon pa'i ba yi lci bas zla gam brtsigs kyang rung bar bshad do/ /yam shing de nyid kyi rtsa rtse 'bri mog bu ram/ mar khu rnams sbyar bas byugs/ 'byor tshe byu ru'am mchong ngam zangs kyi ting la sogs pa'i nod du 'bras 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba dang / de bzhin zas mchog til/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dur ba ku sha rnams kyang 'bri mog gi tsandan la sogs pa'i rdzas dmar pos kha bsgyur/ mar khu dang 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur/ bsreg rdzas rnams rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du shing stegs la sogs pa'i khar gong 'og ma 'dzol ba kha gso dang bcas pa bshams/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas/ zangs ting la sogs pa'i nang du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ tsandan nam 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba/ gzhan yang me yol dkar po/ rdor dril dgang blugs/ ḍā ma ru nang mchod 'thor nas/ sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring byed tshe phur pa lnga'am gcig bsang chu 'thor yab spor ste ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ thab nang gi ting lo/ gzhan yang / rnga/ cha lang / dung la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad dang / nye logs shig tu dpal gtor sman raka gtor bsngo/ bskang ba'i gtor ma/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ phud chang la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang kha blta phyogs dus bshad pa ni/ de yang 'byor na byu ru'am tsandan dmar po'i phreng ba la sogs pa lag tu bzung / gos dmar po gyon/ stan dmar po'i steng du padma'i skyil krung ste rkang pa gnyis kyi brang gcig la gcig sbyar te 'dug la/

bsams pa ni brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dang / khyad par bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bo ma rungs pa dag bdag gis dbang du bsdus nas rang gzhan thams cad phan bde'i lam la 'god par bya'o/ /snyam pas kha 'jig rten pa'i nub drang por bltas la/ dus ni rab dpyid zla ra ba'i dgong myur ram/ de min na'ang zla ba gang rung gi dgong myur la 'go brtsam par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi thab khung rdzas dang yo byad rgyan dang 'dug stangs sogs bshad par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las zab mo yis/ /byin za mnyes byed phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzas/ /legs bshams lha tshogs 'khor bcas la 'bul na/ /lha dbang dbang du sdud la ya mi nga / /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gnyis te/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas rdzas dang yo byad thab khung byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ 'das pa'i me lha 'khor bcas bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul zhing zhar byung / gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs mchod 'bul ba'o/ /dang po bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus sngon du 'gro bas/ rdzas dang yo byad thab khung byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs pa/ mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa ltar na rig 'dzin bskul yan 'bring bsdus ltar na bzlas pa yan rdzogs par byas la/ bsang chu byin rlabs zhi ba bzhin mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas byin rlabs ni gzhan thams cad zhi ba bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dang / zhes pa'i mjug tu/ bsreg rdzas rnams gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba dmar zhing snum pa 'od zer dmar po 'phro bas snod bcud thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li/ nas/ ku ru ku ru'i bar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ thab la bsang chu gtor te/ badzra kro dha dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed kha khyer ram mu ran la lcags kyu zhags pa'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu khru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha sku mdog dmar po shin tu chags pa'i nyams can zhal dkyil dmar zhing snum pa las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba chags pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ra skyes kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas bgrang phreng dmar po dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sma ra'i ag tshom can/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las kyi bar zhi ba bzhin las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ ku sha 'bul ba yang zhi rgyas bzhin sbar ba'i me ni smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi me'am sprang pos lam du bus pa'i me/ yang na seng ldeng la sogs pa shing dmar po gtsub pa las byung ba'i mes thab kyi ting lo sbar zhing / sngags brjod pa/ me kha gso ba'i mar 'bul ba yan 'dra ba las/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dgang blugs padma'i phyag rgyas bzung ba ni lag pa gnyis kyi mthe chung srin lag mdzub mo rnams mthe bong dang sbyar gung mo sbreng ba'i bar nas dgang blugs bzung ba ste phyag rgya 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /me lha'i byon zan 'bul ba'i dmigs pa rnams 'dra ba las/

spel tshig tshe/ ba ha na ya'i rjes su/ khams gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum khyad par du yang stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mkhas pa paṇḍi ta grub pa rig 'dzin gyi phyogs thams cad dang / bye brag tu bstan la gnod byed kyi dgra bo ma rungs pa thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥswāhā/ zhes sbyar bas byon zan phul la/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ me pra brtags pa ni bzang ngan gyi rtags spyi 'gro thams cad zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar las/ khyad par me mdangs dmar zhing 'tsher ba padma'am lcags kyu lta bur 'bar na bzang ngo / /bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni 'bras bu can gyi shing gang rung gi yam shing gang du bshad pa de nyid/ bo dhi bṛkṣa'i sngags gong gi spel tshig dang bcas pas phul/ de bzhin du mar la/ oṃ agne/ 'bras la/ badzra puṣṭa/ zas mchog la/ sarba saṃ pa de/ til la/ sarba pā paṃ/ so ba la/ badzra bi dza ya/ nas la/ mahā be ga gro la/ badzra ghasma ra/ sran ma la/ mahā ba la/ dur ba la/ badzra ā yu ṣe/ ku sha la/ a pra ti'i sngags rnams kyi tshar bdun bdun mthar spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul/ bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil 'bul/ mar blugs gzar gang thabs nang du blugs la sngags dang me lha 'bar ba'i sogs brjod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te/ mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba zhar byung gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs mchod phul ba ni/ de nas mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bud shing rnams kha gsol/ bsang chu gtor/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ ma hā shun+ya ta nas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa res dbu brgyan gyi bar zhi rgyas bzhin las khyad par/ lha rnams rang rang gi sku mdog las cung zad dmar ba chags pa'i nyams can shin tu 'dzum pa 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsgom/ kī la ya/ sngon 'gro'i byon zan spel tshig can du phul/ slar mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas byin gyis gyis brlab/

sgeg phreng༞ rang byung༞ 'khril ba'i༞ nyams pa'i༞ dam tshig chen po༞ he ru ka'i gnas bcu༞ nga ni za byed༞ bla med mchod pa༞ sgeg cing༞ sogs kyis phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid/ bsgral ba rakta/ khams gsum yang sgrol/ gtor ma/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams zhi ba'i skabs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gsum ka gsal gang thebs bya'o/ /bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ gong me lha'i skabs ltar go rim ma 'chug par so so nas lnga bcu lnga bcu'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul ba'am/ yang bsnyen pa'i bcu cha lta bu yin na 'bras la sogs pa grangs bzung / 'bul tshan bcu gcig tshan pa rnams rim pa bzhin 'bul/ gong ltar gnyis ka'i mthar gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun spel tshig dang bcas pa bya/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams kyang zhi ba bzhin bya'o/ /zhar byung gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs mchod rnams bya ba ni zhi rgyas kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar skabs gang babs tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi bdag bskyed sngon 'gro'i thab yo byin rlabs/ mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba sogs zhar byung dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ thugs rjes rjes chags dbang chen phrin las la/ /rgyas kun ye shes snying po bskul ba na/ /khams gsum kun kyang dbang du 'dud par snyam/ /'di 'dra bla ma'i drin las gzhan du gang / /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /spyi don gsum pa mjug chog la'ang gnyis te/ dngos grub blang zhing lhag chad kha bskang / bzod gsol gshegs bsdu me lha lhag mchod gtor 'bul 'dod don zhu zhing gshegs gsol/ lhag chad kha bskang ba go bsgo/ bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya ba la/ dang po dngos grub blangs ba sogs ni/ zhi rgyas nang bzhin la/ 'on kyang me lha'i gtor ma 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur/ gnyis pa go bgo sogs kyang de dag nang bzhin du shes par bya'o/

/de rnams kyis mjug gi cho ga rnams ma tshang bar med par bstan zin to/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis bla med don sgrub phyir/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mkhas grub tshogs/ /rim byon rnams kyis legs par bkral ba yi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs 'di ngo mtshar che/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa drag po'i sbyin sreg la'ang gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ /sngon 'gro la'ang gnyis/ thab khung rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa/ rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang kha lta phyogs dus bshad pa'o/ /dang po thab khung ni rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ /log par lta ba'i gdug pa can/ /mngon spyod haṃ ni sbar bar bya/ /nag po'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ /ngos rer sor ni nyi shu bya/ /sbom du chags 'byed sor bzhi mchur/ /mi rus dur khrod sol bas byugs/ /bud shing tsher ma can gyis bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa stegs khru gang gru bzhi dpangs su mtho gang med pa'i bar ro sol dang snag tsha mi rus kyi phye mas nag por byugs/ de'i khar srad bu btsag gis sbags pa'i thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i dbus nas gsum gnyis phyir bzhag nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su rtsibs bcu'i lte ba dang phyi'i sum gnyis la rtsibs bcu bya/ de'i phyir mu khyud gnyis rim pa bskor ba sor mo nyi shu'i tshad bya/ 'khor lo'i phyi'i slob dpon 'jig rten pa'i lho drang por gzigs pa'i dbang du byas nas 'jig rten pa'i nub byang drang po nas byang shar drang po'i zur steng du thig skud phab la btab/ 'jig rten pa'i byang shar nas 'jig rten pa'i lho'i tshangs thig gi steng du thig skud bzung la btab/ yang 'jig rten pa'i lho nas 'jig rten pa'i nub byang mtshams su thig skud bzung la btab pas gru gsum du 'byung / gang ltar kyang las bzhi char gyi thab khung gi dpe ris sum cha bzhi cha lnga cha sogs yi ge gsal bar bkod pa bzhin logs na bris yod pas der blta bar bya'o/

/de'i phyi nas sor gsum 'jal ba'i sa sngar gyi 'debs pa'i go rim gyis btab pas gru gsum 'byung ba kha khyer/ yang sngar bzhin sor gsum 'jal ba'i sa gru gsum du btab pa mu ran no/ /de'i phyir sor gsum 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa stegs bu/ yang sor gsum mam sor do 'jal ba'i sa gru bzhir btab pa stegs bu'i dpangs tshad yin la/ de lta bu'i thab kyi mu ran la phyogs gsum mtshams gsum du mda' gzhu phyir 'gengs pa gsum/ de dag gi mtshams mtshams su rdo rje rwa gdengs pa re re bri/ thab kyi nang gi zur gsum la khro zhal nang du bstan pa gsum bri/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir rdo rje rwa gdengs pa'i gsham nas zla phyed kyis bskor ba'ang sngar gzhan du bshad pa ltar dang rdul tshon gyi las gzhi thams cad nag po bcad dmar po/ za byed kyi zhal dmar po tshems dkar po/ gzhu sngon po/ mda' ser po/ mde'u sngon po/ zla phyed dkar po/ de steng rdo rje sngon po/ 'khor lo ser po/ mu khyud ljang khus bri ba rnams ni thab bshad pa'o/ /rdzas dang yo byad bshad pa ni/ de yang bud shing ngam yam shing ni rno zhing rtsub pa ste tsher ma can gyi shing gang yang rung ba sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad rtsa rtse ro sol dang khrag gis byugs pa de nyid kyi kha khyer steng nas gru gsum du rtsigs pa'am/ yang na rnga mong ngam bong bu gang rung gi sbangs gru gsum du brtsigs/ de yang ma 'byor na g.yag rgod kyi lci bas gru gsum du brtsigs pa'o/ /gzhan yang rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas mi thod dam lcags la sogs pa'i snod du sha rna/ khrag sna/ dug sna/ ske tshe/ shang tshe/ yungs dkar nag la sogs pa drag po'i rdzas sna gang 'dzoms phyogs gcig tu bsags pa dang / go rim bzhin du spyir btang gi rdzas/ so ba/ sran ma/ til/ nas/ 'bras/ gro/ zas mchog dur ba/ ku sha rnams dang / lcags la sogs pa'i snod du mar khu tsha ba gsum gyis kha bsgyur ba ste/

de yang sman gyi tsha ba gsum ni/ lga dang pho ril pi pi ling / sngo yi tsha ba gsum ni/ lce tsha/ dbyi mong / srub ka rdzas de thams cad ro sol dang khrag gis dmar nag tu bsgyur ba dang / khyad par lcags snod gcig tu dgra dmigs bsal yod na de dag gi dri chen dri chu/ snab/ rkang rjes kyi sa/ skra/ sen mo/ gos kyi dum bu rnams/ bag zan la 'og gi rdzas rnams dang lhan cig tu bsres pa'i liṅga'am/ yang na dmigs bsal ma yin pa'i bstan pa'i spyi dgra thams cad la byed na/ gad pa phar chad tshur chad kyi sa/ gtsang po chen po'i phar 'gram tshur 'gram gyi sa/ grong ste phung ba'i shul gyi sa/ ra thug lug lug gi gcin/ ro sol/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ tsha ba gsum rnams bag zan la bsres pa'i liṅga/ rnam shes brgyad mtshon byed sor brgyad dam/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis mtshon byed sor bcu gnyis su byas pa'i snying kha/ dmigs bsal yod na de'i ming rus bla dwags dur khrod kyi ras la dug khrag gis dbu can du bris pa snying khar gzhug spyir btang la dur khrod kyi ras la gang gi bri rdzas kyi/ garbha nri tri dza mā ra ya rbad/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya rbad/ ha ha mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i ming rus bla dwags rnams kyis mthar mā ra ya btags pa dbu can du bris la snying khar bcug lcags snod du re bas kha bcad de/ lcags kyi rdo rjes mnan la bzhag go /de yang 'grel pa 'bum nag las/ dgra yi dri ma drug la liṅga bya/ /dur khrod ras la ming rus bri/ /snyigs mar bcas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du/ g.yon 'gor byas pa'i lcags snod dam thod pa la sogs pa'i nang du khrag gi mchod yon ni 'byor tshe mi rta khyi gsum gyi khrag dngos sam/ khrag skam chu gtsang la sbyar ba'am/ de yang ma 'byor na g.yag rgod kyi khrag chu gtsang la sbyar ba/ dbang po lnga'i me tog ni zan khrag gis sbrus pa la/

snying mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna lce rnams kyi gzugs dod par bcos la/ tshil chen gyi bdug spos ni rab mi rta khyi gsum gyi tshil/ de ma 'byor na mi tshil rkyang pa'am/ yang ra tshil gyi dum bu mer bsregs shing mchod pa rnams kyi gras su bsgrigs/ zhun chen gyi mar me mi tshil bzhu ba'i khu ba la dur khrod kyi ras btsugs pa'i mar me'am/ yang na mar nag la tshil chen cung zad bsres pa'i mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab ni chu gtsang ma/ mi la sogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi mkhris pa sbyar ba la/ ga pur/ dza ti/ sihla rnams bsres pa'am/ yang na mi tshil gyi dum bu dang gong gi rdzas rnams sbyar/ sha rus kyi zhal zas ni/ sha sna tshogs tshad zan la sbrus pa'i bshos bu stod sum cha zur gsum dbal can/ smad sum gnyis zlum po khrag gis byugs pa me ris kyis brgyan pa bshams/ gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar me yol dkar po gru bzhi dgang blugs rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas/ sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gi phyogs yin na sras mchog gi phur pa/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gdab phur gsum yungs dkar ral gri tho ba/ bsang chu 'thor yab dang bcas pa ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ spor te thab nang gi ting lo rnams dang / dpal gtor sgrub thabs rgyas pa bya ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dpal gtor las chung ba'i khro bcu'i gtor ma dbyibs dpal gtor dang mthun pa bzhi dpal gtor gyi g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis bzhag sman gtor bsngo bskang ba'i gtor ma tshogs chas phyag len rgyas pa'i phyogs yin na bstan skyong gi gtor ma'ang bshams/ gzhan yang rnga dang rol sil rkang gling la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa rgyan dang 'dug stangs bsam pa dang kha blta phyogs dus bshad pa ni/ de yang 'byor tshe raksha dang mi rus kyi phreng ba/ rnga mong dang bong bu'i spu la sogs pa'i phreng thag byas pa lag tu bzung /

skra yod tshe spyi bor bcing / lus la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu rnams bya ba'am/ yang na rdzas de thams cad dur khrod kyi sol ba dang tshil chen la sbyar ba'i sna steng nas bshur 'then pa'am/ yang na gdong thams cad nag por byugs/ gos nag re ba la sogs pa lus la gyon pa'am/ yang na lus gcer bu thal bas byugs/ stan nag po'am/ yang na mi lpags/ stag lpags la sogs pa dang / de min na sa rjen la rkang pa g.yon pa cung zad phyir brkyang pa khro bo'i 'dug stangs sam/ tsog pus 'dug la shin tu khros pa'i sems kyis/ gdug pa can thabs zhi ba gsum gyi 'dul bar mi nus pa dag myur du tshar bcad de rnam shes dag zhing du gnas spar ba'i sgo nas rjes su gzung bar bya'o snyam pas kha lhor phyogs te/ dus rab dgun zla ra ba'i srod dam/ yang na zla ba gang rung gi nyin phyed la 'go brtsams par bya ste/ gsang rgyud las/ lus nag khros pas lho phyogs blta/ /skra yang spyi bor bcings nas su/ /lus la thal ba chen po byugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de rnams kyi thab khung rdzas dang yo byad rgyan dang 'dug stangs sogs ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ shin tu gdug cing ches cher ma rungs pa/ /'jam po'i las kyis 'dul bar mi nus dag /mngon spyod las kyis myur du tshar gcod phyir/ /rdzas rgod sham 'di mkhas grub phyag len lags/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gnyis te/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thab khung rdzas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ 'das te 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas spyi dang khyad par liṅga 'bru khung bcas bskyed cing dgug 'dren bsgral ba'i las las byas te drag po'i thun rdzas gzhan rnams dang lhan cig tu phul te/

slar yang gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul te mchod gtor bya/ zhar byung gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs mchod 'bul zhing bstan skyong la sogs pa bya ba'o/ /dang po bdag bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba'i thab khung rdzas dang yo byad sogs byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed bstim bsreg rdzas mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ de yang bdag bskyed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung las/ 'dir bskul sogs bya ba shin tu 'brel chags pas bdag bskyed rgyas pa nyid nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na thog mar gnas yo byin brlabs bya ba ni/ phur bzlog bzhin te/ gnas dang yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshur byas la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li/ sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gis arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pha la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bid pū ra ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rnga byin 'bebs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum skabs bstun bya/ de nas sgrub thabs kyi gzhung yongs rdzogs bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bklag pas don grub bzhin rig 'dzin bskul yan rdzogs par bya ba ni bdag bskyed do/ /de nas thab khung rdzas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed bstim mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/

thog mar bsang chu byin rlabs bya ba ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin/ de nas bsang chus mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la gtor te/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams me 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can 'ur 'ur sog sog thog thog gi sgra sgrogs pa/ gdug pa can thams cad skad cig la 'joms pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li nas/ ku ru ku ru swāhā'i bar brjod pas byin byis brlabs/ slar yang bsang chu thab khung la gtor te/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi tsha zhing rtsub pa'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa rgyar sor nyi shu dpangs su sor bcu kha khyer dang mu ran la mda' gzhu rdo rje rwa gdengs pa sogs drag po'i mtshon cha du mas spras pa/ nang gi zur gsum nas za byed 'bar ba'i zhal gnam sa lta bu gdangs pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa shin tu tsha zhing rtsub pa'i bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha rab tu khros pa'i gzugs can ra skyes kham bu'i steng na brkyang bskum khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/

lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po las rab tu tsha ba'i me'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar nag khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus shing am gtsigs bsdams pa/ spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing sma ra dang ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas rtse gsum 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon bgrang phreng nag po brla stengs su 'dzin pa/ drang srong gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing sngar zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / hūm̐ 'gro ba'i don du thugs rje'i skur sprul pa/ /me lha'i rgyal po nyon mongs sreg pa'i mchog /'gal byed bsreg phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs nas brtan par bzhugs/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs 'khor bcas brlag pa'i phyir/ /yar gyi bdun brgyud yar la snyogs pa chod/ /pha dang mes po yang mes thams cad sregs/ /mar gyi bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha thams cad sregs/ /'gal byed thal bar rlog phyir spyan 'dren na/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kro dha agne ye hūm̐/ ta ka dza dza/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul/ oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro bas/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ tri shya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyis dam la bzhag badzra yakṣi ni/ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bcings mnyes dbang du byas par bsam/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don nas/

dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig bar gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka sogs nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥ zhes dbang bskur bas/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las karma he ru kas dbu brgyan/ zhes rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la phyogs mtshams thams cad g.yon skor du dgram mo/ /de nas sbar ba'i me ni shan pa'am yugs sa ma'i khyim nas blangs pa'i me'am/ yang na shing gdug can/ rtsub pa las byung ba'i mes spor sde sbar la thab la g.yon skor du bskor la sngags brjod cing me sbar/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum thab la g.yon skor du bskor zhing blugs la/ dzwa la'i sngags brjod cing me kha gsos/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las/ sogs dang / dgang blugs lag mthil du mthe bong bkug srin lag dang gung mo de'i steng nas bkab/ mthe'u chung mdzub mo gnyis sbreng ba khro bo'i sdig mdzub kyis bzung la/ oṃ agne ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ agne ye spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing bsam sbyor phyin ci log tu byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad myur ba nyid du tshar bcad par mdzad du gsol/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul/ de nas mchod bstod zhi rgyas kyi skabs ltar bya ba'am/ yang na bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ hūm̐/ byin za chen po 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /rgyags shing dregs pa ra rgod 'gying ba'i khrir/ /shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku can ni/ /drang srong tshul bzhin dgra bgegs 'joms la bstod/ /ces brjod skabs 'dir me pra brtags pa ni/ bzang ngan gyi rtags thams cad gong zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar las khyad par ni ral gri dang rtse gsum mdung thung gi rnam par 'bar ba dang /

tshags sgra 'ur sgra dud pa kham nag tu 'khyil ba bzang ngo / /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i tsher ma can gyi shing gang yang rung ba rtsa rtse ro sol dang khrag gis byugs pa de nyid drag po 'bar ba'i rdzas su bsam ste/ oṃ ru tra bṛkṣa ye swāhā/ zhes bdun gyi mthar/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i/ sogs spel tshigs dang bcas pa/ de bzhin du gong du snod gcig tu bsags pa'i/ sha sna khrag sna dug sna/ ske tshe/ shang tshe/ yungs dkar nag la sogs pa'i drag po'i rdzas rnams/ mar khu/ so ba/ sran ma la sogs pa rdzas gzhan rnams la cung zad bsres la/ de nas dgang blugs gong gi phyag rgyas bzung nas mar la/ agne/ so ba la/ bi dza/ sran ma la/ ma hā ba la/ til la/ sarba pā paṃ/ nas la/ ma hā be ga 'bras la/ badzra puṣṭa/ gro la/ badzra ghasma ri/ zas mchog la/ badzra paṃ pa de/ dur wa la/ ā yu ṣe/ ku sha la/ a pra ti/ rnams kyis bdun bdun phul ba'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul lo/ /de nas bsang gtor zhabs bsil 'bul ba/ mar dgang blugs gang thab nang du phul te sngags brjod cing me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i bar zhi rgyas dbang gsum dang 'dra bar bya ba ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cing spyan drangs te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas spyi dang khyad par 'brub khung liṅga bcas bskyed cing dgug 'dren bsgral ba'i las bya ste/ drag po'i thun rdzas gzhan dang lhan cig tu phul la/ slar gong ba'i sbyin sreg phul te mchod bstod bya ba/ zhar byung gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs 'bul zhing bstan skyong sogs bya ba ni/ de nas mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bud shing rnams kha gso/ thab khung la bsangs chu gtor/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ ma hā shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ kyi bar zhi ba bzhin las/ de nas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ kaṃ e bhrum̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces dang / de nas/

e ā sha nas/ keṃ ma hā keṃ ka la su me ru maṇḍa la'i rjes su/ e tri ko ni sogs dang / dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /zhes pa'i rjes su gzhan yang mi bskyod par/ bhrūṃ las gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ /khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ /rtse mo rno dbal dgra bgegs phye mar rlog /rab tu 'bar ba me yi glog stong 'khyug /shin tu 'khor ba'i ngang tshul brtan zhing brjid/ /'khor lo'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas rnam par spras/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /sogs nas/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par badzra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar gyi zhi ba bzhin las/ de nas sa skya rang gi phyag len dang bstun te spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol byed tshul brjod na thog mar drag dung dam tshig chen po'i 'gor byed pa bzhin dang / de rjes ban tshang pa'i rgyun gyi gur drag ltar dur khrod smug nag ma'i rol mo 'phar med la rkang gling bcas/ de nas dur khrod smug nag ma'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /rab 'jigs mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /mthing nag ral pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /zhes pa 'di'i bar la dbyangs dang rol mo dzar bcas mjug gsum brdeg len can gyi mjug tu 'then rkang gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas de nas dgu brdungs/ de nas 'then rkang gnyis che ba gcig byas la bzhag 'di nas shur te/ brjid pa'i stobs kyis dregs pa zil gyis gnon/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyi sku la rol/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la spyan 'dren na/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu rol mo blangs la/ 'gal byed bsregs phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes tshig rol dang / de nas dgu brdung bzlog pa bzhin/ de nas/ 'gal byed dgra bgegs gtan nas bsreg pa'i phyir/

/yar gyi bdun brgyud yar la snyogs nas chod/ /pha dang mes po yang mes thams cad sregs/ /mar gyi bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha thams cad sregs/ 'dir rol mo gong bzhin/ de nas/ hūm̐/ steng gi khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /hūm̐ chen ka ra rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ /phag dang smrig bu'i 'khor tshogs thams cad kyang / /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas spyan 'dren na/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la gshegs su gsol/ /'gal byed dgra bgegs yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes so yang mes༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /shar phyogs khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje sgeg mor bcas/ /stag dang bya rgod༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /me mtshams khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /dbyug pa sngon po rdo rje sder mor bcas/ /g.yag dang bya rog 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po yang mes༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud rtsad nas༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /lho phyogs khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /gshin rje'i gshed po rdo rje dur khrod bcas/ /sha ba 'ug pa'i 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /lho nub khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /mi g.yo mgon po rdo rje gtun khung bcas/ /gzig dang kha ta'i 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /nub phyogs khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mor bcas/

/byi la pu shud 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /nub byang khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje mda' snyems bcas/ /ri khyi khra yi 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /byang phyogs khro bo chen po yab yub ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rdo rje rlung 'byin bcas/ /seng ge ce spyang༞ /'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /byang shar khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje gsod byed bcas/ /dred dang sre mong 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /'og phyogs khro bo chen po yab yum ni/ /'jigs rung stobs chen rdo rje rigs byed bcas/ /dom dang byi ba'i 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha thams cad sregs/ /'dir yang gong bzhin tshig rol dgu brdung / hūm̐/ 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom mdzad pa'i 'phrul mo che/ /pu shud bya rog srin bya khra mgo can/ /dregs byed 'khor tshogs bcas pa thams cad kyang / /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞

/bu dang tsha bo༞ /dug lnga'i nyon mongs rnam dag rang bzhin can/ /sras mchog badzra kī la rnam pa lnga/ /dregs byed 'khor tshogs bcas pa༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /rdo rje phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na sa bdag ma/ /dregs byed 'khor tshogs༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpuung 'bar ba'i༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /phyi rab rnal 'byor sgrub po'i grogs byed ces/ /gzhan gyis ma bcol nyid kyis zhal 'ches ma/ /rig 'dzin ma sangs gnas bdag srung mar bcas/ /dregs byed 'khor tshogs bcas pa༞ /drag po 'bar ba'i dbyings nas༞ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la༞ /'gal byed dgra bgegs༞ /yar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /pha dang mes po༞ /mar gyi bdun brgyud༞ /bu dang tsha bo༞ /khrag 'thung ma bdun phra men ma tshogs rnams/ /phur pa'i srung ma phyogs bzhi'i ma mo bzhi/ /dbang phyug yid 'phrog mjug sred nu ma can/ /pho nya'i tshogs rnams khyung gi khra thogs ma/ /la la shin tu mi sdug srin mo'i tshul/ /la la rab tu mdzes pa'i 'od ldan ma/ /la la nam mkha'i mtha' ltar khyab par gnas/ /ma tshogs dpal gyis dam la btags so 'tshal/ /'khor bcas 'bar ba'i dbyings nas spyan 'dren na/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gdan la gshegs su gsol/ /'gal byed dgra bgegs gtan nas brlag pa'i phyir/ /yar gyi bdun brgyud yar la snyogs la chod/ /pha dang mes po yang mes thams cad sregs/ /mar gyi bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha thams cad sregs/ /mdor na rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /ma thogs rengs pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon la/ /bstan la gnod byed dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogs/ /lo zla yun ring bzhag pa'i longs med pas/

/zhag dang za ma'i dus la rtags ston la/ /thams cad gtan nas brlag phyir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing tshig rol dgu brdung mjug tu chems brdung bya zhing gu gul dang tshil chen bsregs/ rkang gling 'bud cing g.yab dar g.yab drag dung 'bud chems brdung sbugs la dpon slob thams cad kyis/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ dmigs pa ni rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun nas glang chen smyon pa dmag la chas pa ltar khro 'khrugs rngam pas zhal gnam sa lta bur gdangs nas mchong shing lding zhing 'ur sgra dang bcas pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam mo/ /de nas rol mo gsum brdeg len can byas la/ sngar zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin dang bcas pas/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes dbang du byas par bsam/ sku gsung thugs byin brlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams kyang zhi ba bzhin bya/ lha thams cad rang rang gi sku mdog las cung zad mthing nag tu gyur cing me stag 'phro ba rab tu khros pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu bgrad cing zhal nas ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa dang zhabs sa gzhi la brdabs pas dbang chen gyi bar du g.yo zhing / nam mkha' las kyang glog dang me dpung 'brug gi sgra lta bu shin tu ya nga bar sgrogs par bsam mo/ /de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ kī la yas bsngags pa'i mar dgang blugs bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa khro bo'i sdigs mdzub kyis thab nang du blugs shing thab kyi kha la g.yon skor du bskor ro/ /slar yang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la bsangs chu la/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba nas/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā'i bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/

de nas rdor dril bzung la/ rdo rje sgeg mo sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin gdong dang bcas pa'am/ yang na bshur ma phyag rgya dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas sogs dang / thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs kyis nang mchod/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen gyis gsang mchod/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas kyis de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ de nas drag dung rol mo rnga brdung dang bcas pas/ dam tshig chen po/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin gyis bsgral mchod/ he ru ka'i sogs kyis rakta'i mchod pa/ nga ni za byed sogs kyis khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa/ de nas sgeg cing dpa' dang / sogs phur 'bring bzhin la/ thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol gyi tshab tu/ thugs dam rjes dgongs drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces sbyar/ 'dod chags khros pa'i sogs dang / bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la bstod kyi bar phur 'bring bzhin rnga rol dang bcas brjod la/ rnga rol rnams bzhag bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim ni/ me lha'i skabs su bshad pa ltar las/ 'on kyang rdzas sngags rnams mi brjod par/ kī la ya/ 'ba' zhig gis rdzas rnams drug cu'am yang na kha skong gi phyir bzhi bsnan la drug cu rtsa bzhi'i re re'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bul lo/ /bsnyen pa lta bu yin na de'i bcu cha'i grangs sran ma'am/ so ba la bzung la 'bul tshan bcu gcig tshan pa re re skabs skabs su 'bul/ de nas khyad par gyi rdzas liṅga 'brub khung bcas bskyed cing dgug 'dren bsgral ba'i las byas te drag po'i thun rdzas gzhan dang lhan cig tu 'bul ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i liṅgaga'i khebs rdo rje dang bcas pa bsal la slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag dpon slob thams cad kyis zhwa gyon/ gu gul tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas liṅga snod dang bcas pa la 'thor tshul byas la/

badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun gyi mdun du e mthing nag las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khung nag po gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba shin tu gting ring zhing zabs pa/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par gnas pa/ 'og nas me dpung dmar nag drag tu 'bar zhing / bar nas khrag mtsho dmar nag khro chu ltar 'khol ba/ nang thams cad dug nad yams nad kyi rlangs pa 'thul zhing / steng nas drag po'i thog ser 'bebs pa/ phyi nas phur srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas lag tu drag po'i mtshon cha thogs te dam nyams la gtub cing rkan sgra rdeb pa/ bar snang thams cad rlung nag rdo rje'i me char bu yug 'tshub cing / me dpung gi phreng bas bskor ba/ thar med las kyi btson khang yi mug cing nag la 'thibs pa'i nang du/ nri ljang gu mas dgra bo/ tri dkar ser las gdon bgegs kyi tshogs lus rid cing nyams thag pa'i kha nas khrag 'dzag cing / sna nas rnag dang / rna ba nas chu ser/ mig nas mchi ma'i rgyun dang 'og sgo gnyis nas khu khrag bshang gci lhug par 'chol ba/ yan lag thams cad lcags sgrogs dang zhag pa nag pos dam du bcings shing / lce dang mig 'bras lug la khad pa/ kha na si sgra dang kyi hud ngud mo'i sgra 'byin pa/ lus thams cad la bar mtshams med par mdze dang phol mig shu bas btab cing rnag khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa/ 'dar zhing skrag pa shin tu ya nga zhing mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni liṅga 'brub khung dang bcas pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas dgug 'dren bya ba ni/ rang dpal chen yab yum du gsal ba shin tu khros pas spyan gsum nam mkha' la bgrad pa zhabs sa la brdab cing bzhad sgra drag po sgrogs pa'i ngang tshul can gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nag po tsha zhing rtsub pa bskal pa'i me lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/

thab khung gi mtha' skor dang dur khrod 'brub khung gi phyi na bzhugs pa'i phur srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phog pas de thams cad 'jigs shing skrags te rang dbang med par srog snying thams cad bdag la phul/ bdag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin nyan par bsam/ yang 'od zer des sras mchog sgo ma phra thabs khro bcu yab yum dang dpal chen yab yum dang bcas pa la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs dam dang thugs rje rang dbang med par bskul te khros 'khrugs rngam pas rang rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa lcags sgrogs dril bu tho ba ral gri la sogs pa mtshon cha dpag tu med pas pho nya rlung gi shugs can gshin rje'i skyes bu lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ de dang dus mnyam du phur srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis kyang / rang rang gi bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa chas te stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams gang / de dag na gnas pa'i bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bgegs ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis rgyab nas ded de kho rang gi las las grub pa'i rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas 'phul/ mun nag gis mdun bsus te kho rang gi gzugs brnyan gyi drung du slebs pa dang / de nyid la 'jug 'dod kyi bsam pa drag po dang ldan par bsam ste/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ dmigs pa rtse gcig dang ldan pas/ skad gsangs mthon pos/ e raṃ e raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ dzaḥ na mo/ zhes mjing drangs dpon slob rnams kyis lhan cig pas/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa la sogs pa brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / khyad par drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' bden pa dang /

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur bu/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ khyad par du yang bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum/ sprul pa'i mche gshog nyi shu/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa dang / nor skyong dur khrod bdag po/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra lcam sring bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i༞ khyad par du yang dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla bdud kyi rgyal po/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ging chen dge bsnyen 'bum sde/ bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dang bcas pa'i༞ chos dbyings gdod nas rnam par dag cing chos can dkar nag la 'bras bslu ba med pa'i༞ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dkar ba'i bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas rnams la gnod cing bsam sbyor phyin ci log pa'i sgo nas lus srog mi nor 'khor 'bangs/

khang khyim/ sa gzhis dang bcas pa la dngos sam shugs kyi sbyor ba rtsub mo'i tshogs kyis gnod 'tshe'i rigs rtsom zhing snga dgra lag la bkal ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra sdang zhing gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs phyi nang gsang gsum gang na mchis pa de dag thams cad skad cig nyid la khug la gzugs dang liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig ces brjod cing ḍā rol drag tu brdung drag dung bus dpon slob thams cad kyis ngag tu/ kī la ya/ dang zhi ba'i bsgral mchod skabs su bshad pa'i/ sarba sha trūṃ na sha ya/ sogs sngags brjod/ slob dpon gyi phyag rgya de nyid dpral ba'i dbyings nas g.yas phyogs su bskor zhing liṅga'i steng du phab/ de bzhin du g.yon dbus rnams su bskor zhing liṅga'i steng du phab pa'i mthar/ rdo rje snying khar bzung / zhes dril bu liṅga ga la g.yas bskor bya zhing dkrol mchod g.yogs pas gu gul gyi dud pa ches cher bya zhing liṅga la bdug go /de nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya zhing / oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje gnod sbyin mo shin tu khros pa dgra bgegs kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bzung ste liṅga'i spyi bor khrid pas chu'i khams nyams par byas/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rab tu khros pas dgra bgegs de liṅga'i spyi bo nas bstim yan lag thams cad zhags pa nag pos dam du bcings pas sa'i khams nyams par byas/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje bdud rtsi ma rab tu khros pa liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i rkang lag lus po thams cad lcags sgrog gis dam du bcings pas bsgral las ma byas kyi bar liṅga dang rnam shes skad cig kyang 'du 'bral med par byas te me'i khams nyams par byas/ dril bu'i phyag rgya bca' zhing dril bu dkrol la/

oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje gsod byed ma rab tu khros pas liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i dbang po'i gnas lngar dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing zhabs kyis brdzis pas dgra bgegs de dran med du brgyal zhing sems dbang myos pas rlung gi khams thams cad nyams par byas par bsam la dril bu dkrol zhing / de nas rol mo rnams bzhag go /yang de 'dra ba lan gnyis re yongs dril lan gsum byas pa'i mtha' ma la lha dbye ba ni/ dgug 'dren 'ching sdom dbang du byas pa'i mthar/ dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rang gi snying kha'i thad du yang yang nang du bkug la/ pañtsa gandhaṃ de wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ dhā tu aṣṭa da sha de wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ dwa dhe sha ya tā nan te wa a karṣa ya dzaḥ sarba de wa rakṣa/ a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod dmigs pa ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros mdun gyi liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba'i snying khar phog pas gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes pa ste phung po lnga la bsrungs skyob byed pa'i lha dang / gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam shes/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid de skye mched bcu gnyis la gnas pa'i lha dang / mig la sogs pa'i khams bco brgyad kyi lha dang / gzhan yang srung skyob byed pa'i lha/ pho lha/ mo lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha/ yul lha/ srog lha/ kha rje/ dbang thang / klung rta la sogs pa'i lha thams cad dang / gzhan yang de'i rgyud la yod pa'i bla ma rnams kyis dbang bskur gyi byin rlabs dang / yi dam gyi bzlas bsgom/ bsrung 'khor/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi snying khar thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas/

gzi brjid nus pa sngar bas kyang ches cher lhag par gyur pa/ dgra bgegs de nyid me tog sad kyis khyer ba'am/ sbrang bu nyi mas tshig pa ltar nag tshom tshom gyur cing mgon skyabs thams cad bral bar bsam/ de nas sa skya rang gi phyag len dang sbyar nas dpang gzugs kyi dbyangs rol sogs brjod na/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril bzung gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol brdungs la mgon po drug cu pa'i dpang gzugs mgon po'i rol mo 'cham tshul dang bcas pa bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje snying kha'i thad nas sdigs mdzub kha phyir phyogs pas bzung / dril bu dku g.yon par 'gying zhing bzung la rnga phyir brdung mgon po'i dpang gzugs kyi dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ bhyoḥbargyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /khyad par phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra yin/ /dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra lags/ /sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byas/ /mtshams med lnga dang nye ba bsags/ /nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshang / /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bkrongs pa ste/ /'di ste sdig pa chen po can/ /mnar med 'gro ba'i bdag nyid yin/ /bdag nyid snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /'jig rten rten 'brel nor rdzas dang / /'dus byas zas kyi longs spyod byin/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis khrid byas nas/ /las ngan 'di las ldog cig ces/ /yang yang gsol kyang ldog ma nyan/ /des na gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /re zhig thugs kyis btang bar 'tshal/ /bdag gis ma nyes ma yo zhing / /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas/ /de ltar legs par gzung du gsol/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang /

/phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bdag la dgongs/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /'di nas rnga brdung myur du btang la/ bla ma'i sku la 'khu 'khu ba/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la 'gom 'gom pa/ /rnal 'byor sku la do bsdo ba/ /bdag kyang 'phags pa rab mchod cing / /gzhan don ci nus bgyid bsams pas/ /dgra bgegs 'di yis ma ster ro/ /spros bral rang bzhin dag pa'i klong / /dbyings kyi thig ler sgom snyam pas/ /bar chad rkyen 'dis ma ster ro/ /bdag gis cung zad ma nyes shing / /rnam pa kun tu ma yo bas/ /de ltar mkhyen par mdzad nas kyang / /mthu stobs bskyed pa'i cho ga mdzod/ /lha dang gnyis su med par bsgom/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i grogs mdzod cig /ces brjod cing rol mo sbram sbram the ba'i dgu brdung bdun brdung rkyang pa gnyis kyi mthar che ba gcig de nas 'then rkang byas la gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas/ de nas gcig nas bcu bcu gcig gi bar dam tshig chen po'i bzhin byas la rdor dril bzhag de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la dpang por gsol bas de dag gis rang nyid bden par dgongs shing / dgra bgegs de nyid la thugs lhag par khrel te bsgral ba'i las mdzad pa la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu gtad par bsam mo/ /de nas sngar bshad pa'i gdab phur gsum las gtso phur slob dpon gyi lag tu bzung la kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba ni/ rnga brdung zhing / dam tshig chen po/ bshur ma yongs rdzogs/ mjug rol mo 'chams tshul dang bcas pas bskul bya/ de'i dmigs pa ni/ de ltar bskul bas nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis mtshon cha dpag tu med pa thogs te/ dgra bgegs la bsnun cing bsad bcad bsgral ba'i las mdzad par bsam la slob dpon gyis phur pa klad la bskor zhing kī la ya brjod la dpral bar bsgril bas sku'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

de bzhin rim pas mar babs la mgrin par bsgril zhing kī la ya brjod pas gsung gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ snying khar bsgril zhing kī la ya brjod pas thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams/ de nas kī la ya kho na 'dren zhing rang gi snying kha'i thad nas phur rtse phyir bstan la sgril zhing kun gzhi'i gnas lugs tshe lung khrus lung gnas spar ba'i cho ga bshad pa ni/ de yang liṅga 'di nyid dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba'i snying khar rtsa bzhi gnas pa ni/ chos nyid rang byung gi rtsa gnyis med ye shes kyi rtsa/ glo bur rgyud 'dzin gyi rtsa/ skyon yon dbang po dngas 'byed kyi rtsa bzhi 'doms pa'i dbus su sha yi dngas ma byi'u men pa'i mgo tsam gyi nang du khrag gi dngas ma mtshal lcogs la lta bu/ de'i nang du rtsa'i dngas ma dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bus dril nas dbugs kyi dngas ma drod kyi rnal par gnas shing / de'i nang du 'od kyi dngas ma nya mig tsam gyi dbus su tshe'i rten sdom gyi rgya lta bu dril nas rnal par shes pa'i ngo bo la dkar po'i rnam par gnas pa ni kun gzhi'i gnas lugs so/ /de nas khrus lung la gsum las dang po khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung ni rang gi snying khar a dkar po bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas de dag gi thugs ka nas a dkar po bya dkar po ldang la bsgrigs pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par 'dus nas rang gi snying khar thim par bsams pa ni khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung ngo / /gnyis pa bdag gi khrus lung ni/ slar yang mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams las a dkar bya dkar gdang la bsgrigs pa lta bu byung ste rang la thim zhing lus gang bas bdag gi nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas par bsam pa ni bdag gi khrus lung ngo /

/gsum pa liṅga gzas pa po'i khrus lung ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros lag tu bsgril ba'i phur pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs rtse mor a dkar po zhig tu gyur/ de nas a dkar po mang po 'phros nas liṅga'i lus la bye ma la char babs pa ltar sib sib lus kyi nang thams cad gang nas kho'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsams pa ni gzas pa po'i khrus lung ngo / /tshe lung la gnyis las bdag gi tshe lung ni/ liṅga'i snying kha'i steng du phur pa ma reg tsam sgril ba'i phur pa'i rtse las 'od zer tshe zhing rtsub pa gnam lcags zhun ma lta bu 'phros liṅga'i snying la thim pas snying ga'i rtsa bzhi gur gyi chon thag chad pa bzhin du gtubs/ sha dang khrag gi dwangs ma rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin rtog gis skams/ rtsa'i dwangs ma rnams dar lce la me bcug pa bzhin thul gyis bsregs/ dbugs dang 'od kyi dwangs ma bye tshan la chu blugs pa bzhin du bcom/ tshe'i rten la phur pa'i 'od zer phog pas sbrang bu me nang du song ba bzhin du chom gyis bsregs te rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po'i bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad phur pa'i rtse'i a la 'dus par bsam/ oṃ laṃ sogs kyi sngags brjod cing snying kha'i thad btsugs/ slar phur pa bton nas phur pa'i dbu rang gi dpral ba mgrin pa snying kha gsum du reg la/ bo dhi tsitta oṃ/ bo dhi tsitta āḥ bo dhi tsitta hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs thams cad rang la thim pas rang gi tshe bsod snyan grags thams cad rgyas par bsam pa ni bdag gi tshe lung ngo / /gnyis pa gzas pa po'i tshe lung ni/ rnam shes spar ba'i cho ga ni/ de nas slar yang phur pa bsgril te/ kī la ya dang / oṃ laṃ/ sogs kyi sngags spel mar brjod la/ sngar gyi shul du btab pas kho'i rnam par shes pa a dkar po de phur pa'i rtse la blangs te phur rtse nam mkha' la bstan te/

zhes brjod pas rnam shes kyi ngo bo a dkar de bya sgro rlung gis bus pa'am skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin 'og min chos kyi dbyings su longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams su gnas spar bar bsam la spros bral gyi ngang la ci gnas mnyam par gzhog pa ni liṅga'i tshe lung dang gnas spar ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas phur pa sman rigs byugs/ phur shul du yungs dkar gyis brab la sngar bzhin btab pa ni kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba'o/ /gnyis pa nyon mongs pa'i skye ba'i sgo lnga dag par bsgral ba ni/ khro bcu kun 'dus kyi phur pa bzung / rol mo 'cham tshul rnga brdung dang bcas pas/ bgegs byed pa yi bdud rnams dang / /sdug bsngal sems la mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bgegs la log par 'dren pa'i bdud/ /zungs shig sdoms shig rnam par chings/ /sdigs shig grogs dang dbye bar gyis/ /rings nas khug la smra ru chug /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ /bdag gi dbang du byas gyur nas/ /bsgo ba'i bka' nyan nus par gyis/ /zhes dang rol mo 'chams tshul dang bcas pas/ kī la ya/ brjod cing phur pa dum tsam sgril la/ hūm̐ pa ra bidyā tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces liṅga'i spyi bor phur pa btab/ de bzhin du/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpung pa g.yas/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis lag pa g.yon/ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpung pa g.yon/ trā sha ya trā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis pus mo g.yas/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥ daṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis kha/ shrī ghraṃ a na ya hū?m̐ phaṭa/ kyis pus mo g.yon/ dzwa la pa ya dzwa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis gsang gnas/ a be sha ya a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis lag pa g.yas/ bindha bindha ya bindha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bol gong bsnol mtshams rnams su btab slar yang phur shul de thams cad thun gyis brab/ phur rtse sman raka kyis byugs/ yang sngar bzhin spyi bo nas bol gong gi bar gyi phur shul thams cad la btab cing gnas de dag tu khro bcu'i rang bzhin gyi phur pa re btab par bsams la mthar spyi bor btab pa ni nyon mongs pa'i skye ba'i sgo lnga dag par bsgral ba'o/

/gsum pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag par bsgral ba ni/ khra phyag sgo ma kun 'dus kyi phur pa thogs la/ rol mo 'cham tshul rnga brdungs bcas/ pho nya bran dang mngags pa'i tshogs/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /mngon spyod ji ltar nges pa dang / /mngon spyod byin rlabs de bzhin mdzod/ /zhes rol mo 'cham tshul mthar chems brdung bcas/ kī la ya brjod cing phur pa yid tsam bsgril la spyi bo'i phur pa'i g.yas su btab cing / ha na ha na badzra/ g.yon du btab cing / da ha da ha badzra/ dpung pa g.yas phur khung gi g.yas su btab cing / pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ g.yon du btab la/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ lag pa g.yas phur khung gi g.yas su btab cing / dzwa la dzwa la badzra/ g.yon du btab la/ su ru su ru badzra/ lag pa g.yon phur khung g.yas su btab la/ mu ru mu ru badzra/ g.yon du btab cing / ka ṭaṃ ka ṭa ye/ dpung g.yon phur khung g.yas su btab la/ dza ye/ g.yon du btab la/ bi dza ye/ pus g.yas phur khung g.yas su btab la/ a dzi te/ g.yon du btab la/ a pa ra dzi te/ kha'i phur khung g.yas su btab te/ mā ra se na g.yon du btab te/ pra mardha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang sngags mgo nas blangs la/ ha na da has pus g.yon phur khung g.yas g.yon/ pa tsa ma thas gsang gnas phur khung g.yas g.yon/ dzwa la su rus lag g.yas phur khung g.yas g.yon/ mu ru ka ṭaṃ/ gis bol gong phur khung g.yas g.yon/ dza ye/ snying kha'i/ shaṃ/ bi dza yes snying kha'i g.yon/ a dzi te/ a pa ra dzi te/ snying kha'i rtse phyogs/ ma ra se na pra mardha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis snying kha'i g.yas phyogs su btab bo/ /yang phur shul thams cad sngar kyi thun gyis brab phur rtse sman raka gis byugs la sngar gyi btab shul thams cad du sngags dang bcas pas btab cing mthar gsang gnas su btab pa ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag par bsgral ba'o/ /bzhi pa ma bdud kyi dmod mos bsgral ba ni/ ral gri thog la rol mo 'cham tshul/ rnga brdung dang bcas pas/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' lung gis/

/sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yi/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru gyis/ /nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /rol mo 'cham tshul chems brdung bcas/ kī la ya/ dang / hūm̐ ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod cing ral gris liṅga'i sked dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ gru mo g.yas g.yon/ lag mgo g.yas g.yon/ brla khung g.yas g.yon/ pus mo g.yas g.yon/ bol gong gnyis rnams bcad la lhu bcu gnyis su bya ba ni ma bdud kyis dmod mos bsgral ba'o/ /lnga pa dge sdig cha mnyam ste bsgral ba ni/ yungs dkar/ ske tshe/ shang tshe/ rdo phye/ lcags phye/ zangs phye/ dur khrod kyi sol ba rnams bsres pa'i thun lag tu bzung la/ rol mo 'cham tshul rnga brdung bcas/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /song zhig lha yin lha yang rung / nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mdzod/ /rol mo 'cham tshul chems brdung dang bcas/ kī la ya/ dang / sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing thun kyis brab pas dgra bgegs kyi phung po rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsams pa ni dge sdig cha mnyam re bsgral ba'o/ /drug pa gtun du brdungs te bsgral ba ni/ tho ba bzung la rol mo 'cham tshul rnga brdung dang bcas/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ /rdo rje me yis snying bsregs nas/ /lus sems rdul bzhin brlag par mdzod/ /khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas/ /lha yang rung ste bsgral bar byas/ /rol mo 'cham tshul chems brdung dang bcas/ kī la ya/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod cing sngar gyi lhu bcu gnyis su bkral ba rnams tho bas brdung la/ oṃ badzra muṅga ra a ko ḍā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ slar yang snying kha nas lus drang por ral gris gshags/ de nas ro ma thams cad dum bu brgya stong la sogs par gtub pa ni/

gtun du brdung ste bsgral ba'o/ /de nas bstab pa la yang spyi bstab dang sgos bstab gnyis las/ dang po spyi bstab ni liṅga'i snod kyi sla nga ral gri dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi lag tu bzung la/ dmigs pa ni/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ro ma de nyid sha yi phung po rus pa'i ri rab rakta'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyis zhwa phud/ rnga nang brdung rol bskor dang bstun la/ ling ro thog mar dbus/ de nas g.yas/ de nas g.yon/ yang dbus su 'bul ba'i stangs ka bcas btegs la rol mo bzhag 'dur byang dang bcas/ baiḍūr sngon po'i rin chen ri rab la/ /nyi zla stong gi 'od zer brdal ba yis/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rol mo 'cham tshul gong bzhin/ rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs dang bcas/ 'od phung sdug po sprin ltar gtibs pa yi/ /'jigs byed rngams stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /za byed bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar pa yis/ /gdug pa thams cad rdo rje'i zhal du bstab/ /rol mo 'cham tshul gong bzhin rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs/ mi bzad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /khams gsum za bar byed pa'i skan sgra can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rol 'chams gong bzhin/ rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs/ sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum zhal du bstab/ /yang sprul mche gshog tshogs kyi zhal du bstab/ /ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi zhal du༞ /sras mchog phur pa'i lha tshogs༞ /khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du༞ /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis zhal du༞ /ging chen dge bsnyen rnams kyi༞ /rdo rje rig 'dzin tshogs kyi༞ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs༞ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad༞ /dpal ldan re ba ti yi༞ /bdud 'dul nag po mched bzhi'i༞ rol 'cham gong bzhin rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs/

'dod chags rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil li li/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i phung po khro lo lo/ /gti mug sha yi phung po thibs se thib/ /dug gsum bsgral ba'i mchod pa bla na med/ /bla med mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /lha tshogs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /rol 'cham gong bzhin de nas dbyangs dang bcas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir dbyangs bstun rol mo mdzad/ dwangs ba'i sems kyis 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /'dir yang gong bzhin rol mo/ sha khrag rus sogs ma lus mchod rdzas rnams/ /'dir yang gong bzhin/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas dgyes shing bsnams su gsol/ /'dir yang rol skor lan bzhi/ dbus/ g.yas/ g.yon/ yang dbus su sngar bzhin ling ro bstab tshul rol mo chems brdung / badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas rol mo sum brdeg len can byas la bzhag ces btab dbyangs kyis 'bul ba ni spyi 'bul lo/ /da ni bye brag tu drag po'i bsreg rdzas gzhan dang sbyar te 'bul ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas/ gong du bshad pa'i sha sna/ khrag sna/ dug sna/ ske tshe/ shangs tshe/ yungs dkar nag la sogs pa drag po'i bsregs rdzas gzhan rnams dang / ling ro cung zad bsres la slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag dpon slob thams cad kyis lag pa g.yas pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad bsangs shing stong par sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ āḥ zhes brjod pas rdzas snod dgra bgegs kyi thod pa bcad ma thag pa dpral ba rang la bstan zhing rgya khyon stong gsum gyi tshad dang ldan par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas nang rdzas rnams ngo bo sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa la rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po drag po'i thun rdzas kyi rang bzhin lang lang khol bar bsam/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mdzub gnyis rtse sbyar/

srin lag gnyis de'i rgyab tu bsnol/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis bzung / mthe chung gnyis gshibs te sbreng ba bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ha ho hrīḥ zhes brjod pas rdzas de dag zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam/ de ltar lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'bul ba ni/ rdzas snod slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon par bzung / g.yas pas khro bo'i sdigs mdzub kha phyir bstan/ gzhan rnams kyis thal mo sbyar la/ mgon po'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi gdangs dang bcas/ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad dag /bsad cing bsgral ba las byung ba'i/ /sha dang rus pa'i phung po spungs/ /khrag dang zhag gi rgya mtsho bskyil/ /don snying nang khrol lang long spungs/ /drag po'i thun rdzas 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs par/ /zad mi shes par byin brlabs 'di/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /khro bcu yab yum mche gshog tshogs/ /sgo ma sras mchog phur pa'i lha/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad dam can ma/ /bcu gnyis sde dang dregs byed tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /dang ba'i sems dang ldan pa yis/ /drag po 'bar ba'i hom khung du/ /ye shes lnga yi me sbar te/ /gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs bsgral phyir du/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs dang bcas/ /rngams pa'i stabs kyis 'bul lags na/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /gnod 'tshe byed pa'i dgra bgegs ni/ /sde dang dpung bcas thams cad kun/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing mchod g.yog pa la grangs 'dzin du bcug la/ kī la ya/ kho na drug cu rtsa bzhis phul ba'i mthar/ gong gi spel tshig dang bcas pas phul/ de nas mar khu gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun gyi mthar spel tshig dang bcas pas phul la dgang blugs thab la g.yon skor du bskor ba sogs me lha'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/

/de nas phyi mchod sgeg phreng / nang mchod/ rang byung / shlau ka gcig sngags bcas bstod pa'i mchod pa/ sgeg cing / sogs phur chung bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ mgrin gcig tu/ ho bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum/ sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags na/ bdag cag snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can rnams/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis ldongs/ shes bya'i snang ba bral/ chos byed kyi gang zag dkon/ bdud nag po kha rgyal te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams par byas pa 'di nyid khyed rnams kyi ye shes spyan gyis ma gzigs sam/ lha'i snyan gyis ma gsan nam/ thugs kyis dgongs par ma gyur tam/ 'on te brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa lags na/ 'di rnams yal bar 'dor ba phod dam/ gal te gdul bya'i zhing du ma gyur pa lags/ khyed rnams la mkhyen brtse nus gsum mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi nus mthu yod na da lta ston pa'i dus la babs lags pas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi mchod pa/ sman raka gtor gsum drag po'i thun rdzas gzhan dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de 'dzin dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su legs tshogs kyi yon tan rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib/

dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ khams gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum 'gro ba ma lus pa'i zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang / kha rje/ dbang thang / lus ngag yid gsum thams cad bdag cag rnams kyi dbang du bsdus nas bstan pa de 'dzin dang bcas pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bye brag tu rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la drag po'i las su gtad pa ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas khyad par du gsod pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la rnam par sdang zhing dus rnam pa kun tu 'tshe bar byed pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams su legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad nyams par byas nas/ nyes kun sdud pa'i rtsa ba mtshams med lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ mi dge bcu/ nyams pa bdun/ zhing bcu'i las kho na byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs spyi dang / khyad par rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa yi rten phur phyungs/ ltag pa'i bdud chod/ gdong gi 'od 'phrogs/ mig 'bras thang la phyungs/ snying khrag zungs khrag dron mo hub kyis drongs/ las kyi rlung gis phul/ 'jigs pa'i mun pas sus/ dus kyi zhags pas chings/ tshe'i 'du byed skus/ dkon pa'i tshe srog dang phrol/ mdor na mi nor rdzas gsum thal ba'i rdul phran tsam yang med pa'i phrin las lo zla ma 'gyangs par myur ba nyid du mdzod cig gnod byed a mu ka sha trum mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/

ces brjod cing thal mo lan gsum brdab pa'i dmod pa 'di'ang bya'o/ /da ni zhar byung gtor bsngo bskang ba tshogs mchod 'bul zhing bstan skyong sogs bya ba ni/ de yang gtor bsngo bskang ba rnams rgyas bsdus ji rigs pa bya zhing / tshogs mchod ni/ 'dir sgrub thabs rgyas pa nas mdzad pa'i dbang du byas nas de'i mjug nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi tshogs mchod rgyas pa bya zhing / bsgral mchod ni/ gong gi des 'thus pas slar mi dgos shing / spyi btab kyi gtor ma phul ba'i rjes su brtan skyong rgyas pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ bka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /zhes pa nas shlau ka gcig la dbyangs rol/ de rjes/ 'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma/ /sogs tshig rkang gnyis bton nas rol mo dang bcas gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i thab khung rdzas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa cho ga'i dngos gzhi ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ shin tu mi bzad drag po'i hom khung dbus/ /dmar nag drag po'i mi 'bar klong dkyil du/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /bsreg rdzas phul bas khams gsum 'dar zhing dngangs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la'ang gsum ste/ dngos grub blangs shing lhag chad kha bskangs te nongs pa bzod gsol/ dam ye gshegs bsdu bya ba/ me lha lhag mas mchod de mchod bstod gtor ma phul zhing 'dod don zhus te gshegs gsol bya ba/ slar yang lhag chad kha bskangs shing go bsgo/ rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal zhing / lhag gtor btang ba bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis mtha' brtan par bya ba'o/ /dang po dngos grub blang ba/ lhag chad kha skong / bzod gsol/ ye dam gshegs bsdu rnams zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa me lha lhag mchod mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sogs ni gzhi thams cad 'dra ba las/

'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ me lha'i gtor ma gru gsum khrag gam 'bri mog gis byugs par bya/ 'di la skyon med de las bzhi so so dang bstun dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gong ltar gtor ma de nyid nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ badzra kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs pa man sngar gyi rnams dang 'dra ba las/ 'on kyang gong du bshad pa'i bstod pa shlau ka gcig pa'i mjug tu/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /sogs sbyar/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar gyi rjes su/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes btags/ de nas bsang gtor phul te gshegs su gsol ba snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang ba sogs ni snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba las 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rtag chad mtha' bsal ba ni/ 'dir sgrub thabs rgyas pa nyams bzhes kyi dbang du byas pas/ rang bzhin sems kyi/ sogs sngags bcas brjod/ dge ba bsngo ba'ang 'dra'o/ /lhag ma ni bsdus pa byed na skabs 'dir bya zhing / sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i rgyas par byed na tshogs bar pa'i rjes su tshogs la longs spyad nas/ tshogs lhag ma rnams snod du spungs la sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i mjug gi lhag ma'i cho ga dbyangs rol bcas bya'o/ /mjug bkra shis kyis mtha' brten pa ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo༞ mtshungs med bla ma༞ sogs ci shes dang / khyad par/

skye med ma skyes mi dmigs༞ sogs phur pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa dang gzhan yang yi dam chos srung nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i lag len rnams ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ las gsum 'dul bar mi nus 'gro gang la/ /mngon spyod drag pos myur du tshar gcod phyir/ /khrag 'thung 'jigs pa'i gzugs su rnam sprul pa/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i thabs 'di ngo mtshar che/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar na rtsa ba'i sa bcad kyi dbang du byas na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin srig ste bzhi/ so so la'ang spyi don gsum gsum/ bye brag so so'i 'phros don bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes 'bar ba'i me chen zhes bya ba ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse mthu stobs nus pa'i cha/ /cha tsam min pa ma lus gcig bsdus pa/ /padma las 'khrungs rang byung sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med pad 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gang de'i zhal las dam chos bdud rtsi'i ro/ /ro mchog legs par myangs pa'i 'khon ston mchog /mchog thun dngos grub stsol mdzad klu dbang sogs/ /rim byon rnams la slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ /'dzam gling 'dren pa brtse chen kun dga' snying / /snying po'i thugs sras rje btsun sku mched zung / /zung dang dbyer med chos rje khu dbon te/ /gong ma rnam lngar lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /rje btsun bla ma kun dga' rin chen mtshan/ /mtshan tsam dran pas bdud kyi dpa' 'phrog pa/ /stobs kyi mgon dang dbyer med de la 'dud/ /de sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnam pa gnyis/ /gzhan yang grub dbang mthu stobs dbang phyug sogs/

/sngags 'chang nyid dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin rim par byon la phyag bgyi'o/ /khyad par 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gzhan ngor gos dkar 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam bsgom la 'gran zla kun bral sngags 'chang rje/ /mkhas grub dbang po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab skyes chen dam pa gang de'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs/ /padma kā ra kun dga' bkra shis mtshan/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer med rnam gnyis la/ /sgo gsum gus pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ /khyad par bdag gi tshe rabs kun gyi mgon/ /rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med grub pa'i dbang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur pa/ /bsod nams rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de lta'i skyes chen rnams kyi rjes zhugs pa/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa blo gros ming can bdag /dam pa rnams kyis thugs rjes rjes bzung kyang / /dug gsum shugs kyis yid kyi dbang po 'grib/ /'on kyang rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la/ /thos bsam bsgom dang bshad sgrub byed snyam yang / /lo zla du mar le lo'i dbang gis g.yengs/ /thos bsam byed pa'ang yid kyi yul du lus/ /de lta mod kyi mchog gsum bka' drin gyis/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / /spyi dang bye brag dam chos sbrang char gyis/ /bdag blo'i bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus par ma gyur na/ /chos tshul thob dang thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi/ /'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma bar do'i bar/ /nam yang 'du 'bral med par bya'o snyam/ /khyad par dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la/ /sngon dus dbang lung man ngag 'khrid la sogs/ /zab rgyas bzhugs mod da lta dus dbang gis/ /de dag thams cad ming gi lhag ma tsam/ /'on kyang bdag gi dam pa'i bka' drin las/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i chos skor cha tsam zhig

/gzhan la med kyang bsod nams bgo skal du/ /thos pa 'di'ang kho bo skal ba bzang / /de lta bas na sbyin sreg 'di nyid kyang / /mkhas grub tshad ma'i gzhung gi dgongs don bzhin/ /rang gi blo gros spobs pa ci mchis kyis/ /phyogs gcig bsdus shing bsdebs pa 'di lags so/ /'di la'ang bdag blo gti mug gis rmongs pas/ /chad lhag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa mchis pa rnams/ /bla ma mchog dang chos kyi spyan ldan gyi/ /mkhas grub rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/ /'di brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba gang / /gang dang kunda'i mdog ltar rab dkar ba/ /dkar bzang nyon mongs dri bral dge ba des/ /'gro kun he ru ka dpal thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes 'bar ba'i me chen zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal bstan rin po che'i zhabs 'degs sku rim du rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod gtor bzlog las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bcas dgos pa shar tshe/ sgrub mchod gtor bzlog rnams sngon byon gong ma'i phyag len ltar dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'di sa lugs la dar so chung gshis yig cha bsgrigs rtsom gsal kha can zhig med pas rkyen byas/ dbu byed rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / shes rab bstan 'dzin nas lag len khrigs chags shig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rtsa ba'i yig cha slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i 'grel pa 'bum nag dang / slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i yakṣa me dbal bsreg pa'i 'phyong dang / sngags 'chang rgya gar ba'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge sa lo'i dgongs pa bzhin sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phyag len bkod de gsal bar mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg phrin las lhun grub dang / de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje las bzhi'i sbyin sreg
